Surendra A, Byrappa B, Ningombam D, Shru · 2025 rct
Prospective RCT (n=40, single posterior mandibular implants in healed ridges, 1:1 randomization to flapless soft-tissue punch vs full-thickness mucoperiosteal flap; 4.0 × 10 mm implants; 6-month follow-up with periapical radiographic crestal bone loss measurement).

A preclinical model links osseo-densification due to misfit and osseo-destruction due to stress/strain
Coyac BR, Leahy B, Salvi G, Hoffmann W, · 2019 animal
Preclinical in vivo animal study (rat maxillary extraction sockets; control = minimal implant–osteotomy misfit vs test = high misfit that osseo-densified the peri-implant bone), designed to link misfit, insertion torque, and implant stability to their short- and longer-term effects on peri-implant bone — the only held paper besides Trisi 2011 that *assigns* the mechanical exposure rather than binning it post-hoc.
전임상 생체 내 동물실험 (쥐 상악 발치와; 대조군 = 임플란트–골삭제 간 최소 미스핏(misfit) vs 시험군 = 주위골을 골밀도화 (Osseodensification, OD)시키는 고도 미스핏) — 미스핏·삽입 토크 (Insertion Torque, IT)·임플란트 안정성이 주위골에 미치는 단기·장기 효과를 연결하는 설계이며, 보유 논문 중 Trisi 2011과 함께 노출을 **사후 분류가 아니라 실험적으로 배정한** 단 두 편 중 하나다.

양 하악 분할-구강 동물실험(5마리, 임플란트 40개, 6주): 과삽입토크(HT=평균 110 Ncm) vs 저토크(LT=10 Ncm) 조직학·생체역학 비교.

Influence of rough micro-threaded and laser micro-textured implant-neck on peri-implant tissues: A systematic review
Wayel Mohammed Huraib, Fawaz Pullishery, · 2023 sr
Systematic review (PRISMA) of 15 controlled human clinical studies (6 RCT, 5 prospective, 4 retrospective; 2013–2022) comparing rough micro-threaded or laser micro-textured (LMS) implant-neck designs against smooth machined-neck implants for marginal bone loss (MBL) and peri-implant soft tissue outcomes; meta-analysis was not feasible due to heterogeneity. Rough micro-threaded necks showed markedly lower post-loading MBL (0.12±0.17mm to 3.25±0.4mm) than smooth machined necks (0.38±0.51mm to 3.75±0.4mm); LMS-neck implants showed lower 3-year probing depth (PD) than machined-neck implants (2.3±0.7mm vs 3.8±0.8mm), with similar gingival recession between groups. Roughened micro-threaded/laser-microtextured neck designs significantly reduce functional-loading MBL and PD versus machined necks, but all included RCTs had short follow-up (mostly 12–24 months) and four studies found no significant between-group MBL difference — long-term (>5yr) RCTs are still needed.
PRISMA 체계적 문헌고찰(SR) — 15편의 대조 임상연구(RCT 6편, 전향적 5편, 후향적 4편; 2013–2022년), 거친 미세나사산(micro-threaded) 또는 레이저 미세조직화 표면(Laser Micro-textured Surface, LMS) 임플란트 넥 디자인을 매끄러운 기계가공(machined) 넥과 비교해 변연골소실(Marginal Bone Loss, MBL) 및 임플란트주위 연조직 결과를 평가; 연구 간 이질성으로 메타분석은 시행하지 못함. 거친 미세나사산 넥은 부하 후 MBL이 매끄러운 넥(0.38±0.51mm~3.75±0.4mm)보다 뚜렷이 낮음(0.12±0.17mm~3.25±0.4mm); LMS 넥은 3년 시점 탐침깊이(Probing Depth, PD)가 기계가공 넥보다 낮음(2.3±0.7mm vs 3.8±0.8mm), 치은퇴축은 두 군 간 유사. 거친 미세나사산·레이저 미세조직화 넥 디자인은 기능부하 하 MBL·PD를 유의하게 감소시키지만, 포함된 모든 RCT의 추적기간이 짧고(대부분 12–24개월) 4편은 군 간 유의차가 없어 5년 이상 장기 RCT가 추가로 필요함.

Nanofeatured Titanium Surfaces for Dental Implants: A Systematic Evaluation of Osseointegration
Cristina Maria Șerbănescu, Viorel Ștefan · 2025 sr
Systematic review (PRISMA 2020, no meta-analysis; 25 studies: 4 human clinical [2 RCT, 2 non-randomized], 10 in vivo animal, 1 in vitro, 10 combined in vitro/in vivo) comparing nanocoated/nanostructured titanium implant surfaces (TiO2 nanotubes, HA/Ca-P, Ag, Sr, Zn/Mg, graphene/nanospikes) against conventional microrough (chiefly SLA/machined) titanium controls. 21/25 studies favored the nanosurface on ≥1 osseointegration metric (e.g., Ko et al. 2024 RCT: ISQ ~76.5 vs 71.3 at 2 months, ~79.1 vs 73.4 at 4 months, both p<0.01/p<0.0001; Li et al. 2023 dog model: BIC 76.6% vs 44.1% at 12 weeks for Sr-loaded vs plain TiO2-nanotube); gains are largest at 2–4 weeks and commonly converge with microrough controls by 8–12 weeks; GRADE certainty for patient-important clinical outcomes (MBL, survival) is low to very low. Nanofeatures accelerate early osseointegration and can add antibacterial activity without cytotoxicity, but no consistent long-term (≥12-month) survival/marginal-bone-loss advantage over contemporary microrough titanium is demonstrated — the authors call for adequately powered, preregistered ≥3–5-year head-to-head RCTs.
체계적 문헌고찰(PRISMA 2020, 메타분석 미시행; 연구 25편: 인체임상 4편[RCT 2, 비무작위 2], 동물생체내 10편, 시험관내 1편, 병합 10편) — 나노코팅/나노구조화 티타늄 표면(TiO2 나노튜브, HA/인산칼슘, 은(Ag), 스트론튬(Sr), 아연/마그네슘(Zn/Mg), 그래핀/나노스파이크)을 기존 마이크로거칠기(주로 SLA/기계가공) 티타늄 대조군과 비교. 25편 중 21편이 최소 1개 골유착 (Osseointegration) 지표에서 나노 표면 우위(예: Ko 등 2024 RCT — 임플란트 안정성 지수 (Implant Stability Quotient, ISQ) 2개월 ~76.5 vs 71.3, 4개월 ~79.1 vs 73.4, 모두 p<0.01/p<0.0001; Li 등 2023 개 모델 — 골-임플란트 접촉률 (Bone-to-Implant Contact, BIC) 12주 76.6% vs 44.1%[Sr첨가 vs 순수 TiO2나노튜브]); 격차는 2–4주에 최대, 8–12주면 대조군과 수렴하는 경우多; 환자-중요 임상결과(변연골소실, 생존율) 대상 GRADE 확신도는 낮음~매우낮음. 나노 표면은 초기 골유착을 가속하고 세포독성 없이 항균 효과를 더할 수 있으나, 현대 마이크로거칠기 티타늄 대비 장기(≥12개월) 생존율·변연골소실 우위는 입증되지 않음 — 저자들은 사전등록된 ≥3–5년 head-to-head RCT가 필요하다고 결론.

High Insertion Torque—Clinical Implications and Drawbacks: A Scoping Review
Manfredini M, Ghizzoni M, Cusaro B, Bere · 2025 sr
Scoping review (PRISMA-ScR; PubMed + Scopus, 2011–2024; 11 human clinical studies) on whether high insertion torque (IT >50 Ncm) harms marginal bone, facial soft tissue, and implant survival. Narrative conclusion: high IT secures primary stability but is associated with more MBL (mandible 1.53 vs 1.03 mm; maxilla 1.16 vs 0.96 mm, 3 years) and more facial recession (mandible −1.40 vs −0.26 mm; maxilla −0.54 vs 0.03 mm, 36 months), modified by bone density and buccal bone thickness; failures cluster in D1 and D4 bone. No meta-analysis, headline numbers trace to a single 3-year trial, and the post-hoc torque-classification confound is not addressed — it records a harm-leaning 2025 view but does not overturn the Lemos 2020 SR+MA null.
주제범위 문헌고찰 (Scoping Review; PRISMA-ScR, 사람 임상연구 11편): 고삽입토크 (High Insertion Torque, IT >50 Ncm)가 변연골 소실 (Marginal Bone Loss, MBL)·협측 연조직·생존에 해로운지 정리. 서술적 결론: 1차 안정성 (Primary Stability, PS)은 확보되나 MBL 증가(하악 1.53 vs 1.03 mm, 3년)·협측 퇴축 증가(하악 −1.40 vs −0.26 mm, 36개월), 골밀도·협측골 두께 (Buccal Bone Thickness, BBT)가 조절; 실패는 D1·D4 골에 집중. 메타분석 없음·핵심 수치는 단일 3년 연구 유래·토크 사후 분류 교란 미논의 — Lemos 2020 체계적 문헌고찰·메타분석 (SR+MA)의 무의 결론을 대체하지 않는다.

High Insertion Torque → Primary Stability, Crestal Bone Remodeling, and Marginal Bone Loss — A Conflict Synthesis
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Five papers on high insertion torque (IT) that appear to disagree — Trisi 2011 (sheep split-mouth histology, 40 implants, 110 vs 10 Ncm), Marconcini 2018 (RCT, 116 healed-site single implants, 3 y), Aldahlawi 2018 (retrospective, 113 NobelActive), Faot 2019 (prospective, 62 narrow ø2.9 mm implants in atrophic edentulous mandibles, 1 y), and Lemos 2020 (SR+MA, 6 studies / 651 implants) — resolve once IT is read not as an applied dose but as a *readout of the bone that resisted it*; a sixth paper, Coyac 2019 (rat, assigned misfit), was added on 2026-07-17 and supplies the compression-harm pathway the original five lacked.
고삽입토크(IT) 5편은 서로 어긋나 보이지만 — Trisi 2011(양 분할구강 조직학, 40개, 110 vs 10 Ncm), Marconcini 2018(RCT, 치유부위 단일 116개, 3년), Aldahlawi 2018(후향, NobelActive 113개), Faot 2019(전향, 위축 무치악 하악 세경 ø2.9mm 62개, 1년), Lemos 2020(SR+MA, 6편/651개) — IT를 *투여한 용량*이 아니라 *저항한 골을 읽은 값*으로 보면 정합적으로 풀린다. 2026-07-17에 6번째로 Coyac 2019(쥐, 미스핏 배정)가 추가돼, 5편에 없던 **압축→해악의 생물학적 경로**를 공급한다.

The Five Thread Guideline: A New Guideline for Predicting Primary Stability With Dental Implants
Robert Stanley · 2020 case-report
Case letter (3 immediate-placement cases) proposing the Five Thread Guideline (5-TG): a minimum of five implant threads must engage native bone — assessed via CBCT virtual planning with SIMPLANT 17 (bone rendering toggled off) — to predict adequate primary stability, supplemented by a "socket stabilization" concept of bi- or tri-socket wall engagement.

발치와 보존술(ARP) — 분류·재료 선택·치유기전·임플란트 충분성 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Multi-paper synthesis (animal landmark, micro-CT, several RCTs, prospective split-mouth, narrative classification, retrospective cohorts, SR+MAs) on alveolar ridge preservation (ARP): ARP reduces but does not eliminate post-extraction ridge loss (untreated: ~50% horizontal, 30–40% vertical within 6–12 months; bundle bone loss is obligate and immediate implant placement alone cannot prevent it).
다편 종합 — 발치와 보존술(Alveolar Ridge Preservation, ARP)은 발치 후 치조제 손실을 줄이지만 없애지는 못함(무처치 시 수평 ~50%·수직 30–40% 손실; 다발골(bundle bone) 소실은 필연적이며 즉시식립 단독으로도 막지 못함).

Vora et al. · 2025 sr
Systematic review of 14 studies (8 RCTs, 2 CCTs, 5 cohort; 571 molar sites) comparing alveolar ridge preservation (ARP) vs spontaneous healing (SH) for subsequent implant placement at molar sites.
14편(8 RCT·2 CCT·5 코호트; 571 구치부 발치와) 체계적 문헌고찰 — 구치부에서 치조제 보존술 (Alveolar Ridge Preservation, ARP) vs 자연치유 비교.
VS
Learn, unlearn, and relearn post-extraction alveolar socket healing: Evolving knowledge and practices
Melissa Rachel Fok, Lijian Jin · 2024 sr
Narrative review with an embedded overview-of-systematic-reviews (Journal of Dentistry 2024) on post-extraction alveolar socket healing — screened 459 records, included 11 systematic reviews (3 with meta-analysis, 1 network meta-analysis) on unassisted-healing dimensional change, all AMSTAR-2 "critically low" quality, plus narrative synthesis of histology, sinus pneumatisation, clinical/procedural/site factors, and alveolar ridge preservation (ARP) efficacy/technique/cost-effectiveness.
발치 후 치조와 치유(post-extraction alveolar socket healing)에 관한 서술적 리뷰(narrative review) + 삽입된 체계적 문헌고찰들의 개관(overview of SRs) (Journal of Dentistry 2024) — 459편 중 11편의 SR(3편은 메타분석 포함, 1편은 네트워크 메타분석)을 선정했고, 비보조 치유(unassisted healing)의 치수변화 근거는 AMSTAR-2 기준 전부 "critically low" 품질이었으며, 조직학·상악동 함기화(sinus pneumatisation) 논쟁·임상/시술/부위 요인·치조제보존술(Alveolar Ridge Preservation, ARP) 효능·기술변수·비용효과까지 종합했다.

Alveolar Ridge Preservation Using Open Healing with a Sugar-Crosslinked Collagen/Hydroxyapatite Sponge: A Case Series
Friedmann A et al. · 2026 case-report
Prospective case series (n=49 patients, 62 extraction sites) evaluating alveolar ridge preservation (ARP) with a sugar-crosslinked collagen/hydroxyapatite (SCLC/HA) sponge under intentional open healing (cross-suture only, no membrane, no primary flap advancement); inclusion required ≥50% residual buccal bone post-extraction.
전향적 증례시리즈 (49명, 62부위) — 당 가교 콜라겐/수산화인회석 (Sugar-Crosslinked Collagen/HydroxyApatite, SCLC/HA) 스펀지를 개방치유 (Open Healing) 방식(봉합만, 차폐막·판막 없음)으로 치조제 보존술 (Alveolar Ridge Preservation, ARP) 적용; 협측골 ≥50% 잔존 적응증.
VS
Histological Outcomes of Alveolar Ridge Preservation vs Spontaneous Healing: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
Benekou I et al. · 2025 sr+ma
Systematic review and meta-analysis of 22 RCTs (n=816; 505 ARP / 311 spontaneous healing) evaluating biopsy-confirmed histomorphometric outcomes — new bone formation (%), connective tissue (%), and residual graft content (%) — after alveolar ridge preservation versus spontaneous healing; PRISMA 2020, random-effects model, GRADE moderate certainty.
체계적 고찰 및 메타분석 (Systematic Review + Meta-Analysis, SR+MA) — 22개 무작위대조시험 (Randomized Controlled Trial, RCT) (816명; 치조제 보존술 (Alveolar Ridge Preservation, ARP) 505 / 자연치유 311) — 발치 후 생검으로 확인한 조직형태학적 결과(신생골 형성률·결합조직률·잔존이식재율) 비교; PRISMA 2020, 변량효과 모형, GRADE 중간 확실도.

Iosif El-Sioufi, Ilias Oikonomou, Despin · 2023 rct
Four-arm RCT (n=41 patients, single-center, Athens) comparing FDBA+collagen sponge (A), FDBA+free gingival graft (B), DBBM+FGG (C), and FGG alone (D) for alveolar ridge preservation, with clinical vertical/horizontal measurements at extraction and 4 months.
4군 무작위대조시험 (Randomized Controlled Trial, RCT) (n=41명, 아테네 단일기관) — 동결건조골 동종골 (Freeze-Dried Bone Allograft, FDBA)+콜라겐 스펀지 (Collagen Sponge, CS)(A군), FDBA+유리치은이식 (Free Gingival Graft, FGG)(B군), 탈단백우골 이종골 (Deproteinized Bovine Bone Mineral, DBBM)+FGG(C군), FGG 단독(D군) 비교 — 발치 직후·4개월 후 임상 계측.

Survival and Success Rates of Endodontically Treated Teeth Restored with Full Veneer Crowns or Full Cuspal Coverage onlays: A Systematic Review
Jonathan Lane, Ariyan Sadeghzadeh-Araghi · 2024 sr
This systematic review (PRISMA, PROSPERO CRD42022287217; 11 studies from 1707 screened) compared survival and success rates of endodontically treated posterior teeth restored with full veneer crowns versus full cuspal coverage onlays. Onlay survival was 95–100% (2yr) / 90.7–100% (3yr) and success 86.6–96.6% (2yr) / 86.6–96% (3yr); full veneer crown survival was 87.8% (>2yr) / 95.1% (3yr) / 84–97.73% (5–10yr) and success 91.11–92.64% (5yr) / 60% (6yr) — overlapping ranges, no meta-analysis possible (narrative synthesis only), 3/11 studies at serious risk of bias. The authors conclude onlays are favourable over full veneer crowns in the short-to-midterm for restoring endodontically treated posterior teeth, given comparable survival with substantially less tooth-structure removal.
근관치료 구치 수복에서 전장관 (Full Veneer Crown, FVC)과 교두피개 온레이 (Full Cuspal Coverage Onlay)의 생존율·성공률을 비교한 체계적 문헌고찰 (Systematic Review, SR)이다 (PRISMA, PROSPERO CRD42022287217; 1707편 중 11편 최종 포함). 온레이 생존율은 2년 95–100%·3년 90.7–100%, 성공률은 2년 86.6–96.6%·3년 86.6–96%였고, 전장관은 생존율 2년초과 87.8%·3년 95.1%·5–10년 84–97.73%, 성공률 5년 91.11–92.64%·6년 60%로 — 두 군 범위가 겹쳐 메타분석 (Meta-Analysis, MA)은 불가능했고 서술적 종합에 그쳤으며, 11편 중 3편은 심각한 편향위험으로 평가되었다. 저자들은 생존율이 비슷하면서 치질 삭제량이 현저히 적다는 근거로, 근관치료 구치 수복 시 단기~중기적으로 온레이가 전장관보다 유리하다고 결론지었다.

🟡 조건부 반박prosthetic-materials/abutment-screw
Torque Accuracy of Spring-Style Dental Torque Wrenches After Repeated Mechanical Loading and Sterilization: An In Vitro Study
Batuhan Aydın, Zehra Gülerol Aydın, Serk · 2026 in-vitro
In vitro bench study: 9 spring-style mechanical torque-limiting devices (3 each from Implance, Astra Tech, DIO) mounted on their own manufacturer's implant in a resin block and cycled 40 times through mechanical loading plus 134 °C steam sterilization, measured with a calibrated digital torque tester by a single investigator. Torque accuracy was strongly manufacturer-dependent and drifted with service life: overall median percentage deviation 3.33% (Astra Tech), 11.43% (Implance), 16.67% (DIO), with measurements outside the ±10% tolerance band in 5%, 60%, and 95% of readings respectively (χ²=99.241, p<0.001); experimental cycle affected torque difference in all three brands (p=0.004 / <0.001 / 0.007) with a significant cycle × manufacturer interaction (p<0.001). Clinically, spring-style design alone does not guarantee tolerance — the specific MTLD–implant-system combination must be verified at the exact torque used for both placement (35 Ncm) and abutment screw tightening (25 Ncm) — but the exceedance is a property of brand and service history, not of spring-style geometry per se; limits are 3 devices per manufacturer, one operator, and mechanical loading confounded with sterilization.
In vitro 벤치 연구: 스프링식 기계식 토크제한장치(Mechanical Torque-Limiting Device, MTLD) 9개(Implance·Astra Tech·DIO 각 3개)를 각사 임플란트에 연결해 기계적 반복 하중(목표 토크별 10회) + 134°C 증기소균을 40회 반복하고, 교정된 디지털 토크 테스터(정확도 ±0.2% full scale)로 단일 연구자가 측정했다. 제조사별 정확도 차이가 크고 사용 이력에 따라 변했다 — 전체 평균 백분율 편차(Percentage Deviation)는 Astra Tech 3.33%, Implance 11.43%, DIO 16.67%였고, ±10% 허용범위 초과 측정 비율은 각각 5%, 60%, 95%(χ²=99.241, p<0.001)였다. 실험 사이클(Experimental cycle)이 세 제조사 모두 토크차이에 유의한 영향을 주었고(p=0.004/<0.001/0.007), 사이클×제조사 상호작용도 유의했다(p<0.001). 임상적으로 스프링식 설계만으로는 허용정확도를 보장하지 못하므로 실제 사용하는 MTLD-임플란트 시스템 조합을 식재(35 Ncm)·abutment 나사 체결(25 Ncm) 각각의 토크값에서 검증해야 한다. 다만 본 연구의 허용범위 초과율은 기재 구조 자체가 아니라 제조사와 사용 이력의 함수이며, 한계는 제조사당 3개 기기·단일 연구자·기계하중과 소균의 혼재이다.

Prognosis of intentional replantation for periapical periodontitis teeth: a systematic review and meta-analysis

Landmark narrative review (Nair 2006, Int Endod J) drawing on serial block-biopsy histobacteriology to systematize the six biological causes of persistent post-treatment apical periodontitis: intraradicular biofilm infection, extraradicular infection (periapical actinomycosis), foreign-body reaction, cholesterol crystals, true apical cyst, and scar tissue healing.
Nair (2006, Int Endod J) 연속 블록생검 조직세균학(histobacteriology)에 근거한 이정표적 종설: 근관치료 후 잔존 치근단치주염의 6가지 생물학적 원인 — ①근관 내 바이오필름 감염, ②근관 외 감염(치근단 방선균증), ③이물반응, ④콜레스테롤 결정, ⑤진성 근단 낭종, ⑥반흔 치유 — 을 정립.

치주염의 원인을 'red complex' 특정 병원균 패러다임에서 벗어나 다균종 시너지·dysbiosis로 설명하는 PSD (Polymicrobial Synergy and Dysbiosis) 모델 제안 Narrative review — 쥐 실험에서 P. gingivalis는 전체 미생물의 <0.01%만으로도 dysbiosis 유도 가능.

Cross-sectional strain-identification study (n=153 postmenopausal women, OsteoPerio/WHI ancillary cohort) validated a novel P. gingivalis intergenic spacer region (ISR) amplicon-sequencing method able to resolve strain identity, something 16S/shotgun microbiome methods cannot do.

Breaking bad: Manipulation of the host response by Porphyromonas gingivalis
Hajishengallis G, Lamont RJ · 2014 narrative-review
Narrative review systematically detailing the molecular arsenal of P. gingivalis immune subversion at three levels: (1) epithelial invasion via FimA–β1-integrin with SerB dephosphorylation of NF-κBp65 suppressing CXCL8; (2) gingipain-mediated C3 degradation (all complement pathways blocked) while independently generating C5a; (3) C5aR–TLR2 crosstalk in macrophages suppressing iNOS killing and IL-12/IFN-γ via cAMP-PKA–GSK3β and ERK1/2-IRF-1.
P. gingivalis 숙주 면역 조작의 분자 기전 3단계 Narrative review: (1) FimA–β1-integrin 침투 + SerB CXCL8 억제; (2) gingipain의 C3 분해(보체 전 경로 차단) + 독자적 C5a 생성; (3) C5aR–TLR2 crosstalk으로 대식세포 iNOS·IL-12/IFN-γ 억제.

Defining Porphyromonas gingivalis strains associated with periodontal disease
Murugaiyan V, Utreja S, Hovey KM, Sun Y, · 2024 cross-sectional
Cross-sectional strain-identification study (n=153 postmenopausal women, OsteoPerio/WHI ancillary cohort) validated a novel P. gingivalis intergenic spacer region (ISR) amplicon-sequencing method able to resolve strain identity, something 16S/shotgun microbiome methods cannot do.
단면 연구(cross-sectional), 폐경 후 여성 n=153(OsteoPerio/WHI 코호트) 대상, 16S/shotgun 분석법이 하지 못하는 P. gingivalis 균주 수준 식별을 가능케 하는 신규 intergenic spacer region (ISR, 유전자간 스페이서 부위) 시퀀싱법 검증.
VS
Beyond the red complex and into more complexity: the polymicrobial synergy and dysbiosis (PSD) model of periodontal disease etiology
Hajishengallis G, Lamont RJ · 2012 narrative-review
Narrative review proposing the PSD (Polymicrobial Synergy and Dysbiosis) model to replace the reductionist "red complex" paradigm — periodontitis results from a synergistic dysbiotic community, with P. gingivalis acting as a keystone pathogen despite comprising <0.01% of total microbiota in mouse gavage experiments.
치주염의 원인을 'red complex' 특정 병원균 패러다임에서 벗어나 다균종 시너지·dysbiosis로 설명하는 PSD (Polymicrobial Synergy and Dysbiosis) 모델 제안 Narrative review — 쥐 실험에서 P. gingivalis는 전체 미생물의 <0.01%만으로도 dysbiosis 유도 가능.

🟡 조건부 반박dentin-hypersensitivity
Dental pain induced by an ambient thermal differential: pathophysiological hypothesis
["Le Fur-Bonnabesse A", "Bodéré C", "Hél · 2017 narrative-review
An ambient cold-to-warm thermal gradient (outdoor → indoor) can trigger delayed, diffuse, sustained dental pain — a form of thermal allodynia distinct from classical dentin hypersensitivity (DH), documented in three female patients aged 49–55 whose pain was unresponsive to standard DH treatments. The authors propose a four-step mechanism: repeated thermal cycling shifts dentinal fluid outward (140% greater velocity in cold→warm sequences), induces phenotypic neuroplastic changes in C-fiber nociceptors, lowers TRPV1 activation threshold into the innocuous warm range via peripheral sensitization and NGF upregulation, and drives central sensitization producing diffuse, midline-crossing pain. Effective management targets pulpal thermal insulation (veneers, mouthguards) rather than tubule occlusion, and TRP channel antagonists are proposed as a future pharmacological avenue.
외부 한랭 환경에서 실내로 이동할 때 발생하는 환경 온도차(cold→warm gradient)가 기존 상아질 과민증(Dentin Hypersensitivity, DH)과 구별되는 지연성·광범위·지속성 치통을 유발할 수 있으며, 표준 DH 치료에 반응하지 않은 3명의 여성 증례로 뒷받침된다. 저자들은 4단계 병태생리 기전을 제안한다: ①반복 온도 순환에 의한 치수외액 유속 증가(140%)→②C 섬유 신경가소성 변화→③TRPV1 활성화 역치 저하(말초 감작)→④삼차신경 중추 감작으로 이어지는 cascade. 치료는 치수 열차단(비니어·마우스가드)이 핵심이며, TRP 채널 길항제가 차세대 치료제로 제안된다.

What is the effectiveness of antibiotic prophylaxis in preventing early complications following implant surgery? A systematic review
Dubedout J, Podda GM, Fénelon M, Fricain · 2025 sr
Systematic review (PROSPERO CRD42023427802; PubMed/Scopus/Web of Science to May 18, 2023) of 7 double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs, 1,846 participants, testing whether preoperative antibiotic prophylaxis prevents early osseointegration complications and implant failure within 6 months in immunocompetent patients.
- 이중맹검 위약대조 무작위대조시험 (Randomized Controlled Trial, RCT) 7편·참여자 1,846명 체계적 문헌고찰 (Systematic Review, SR; PROSPERO CRD42023427802): 면역정상 환자의 임플란트 식립 전 항생제 예방투여 (Antibiotic Prophylaxis)가 술후 6개월 내 조기 골유착 합병증·실패 예방에 유효한지 평가. - 아목시실린 6편+클린다마이신 600mg 1편 전 시험에서 임플란트 실패·수술 합병증 유의차 없음(전부 p > 0.05; 최근접 Nolan 등 0/27 vs 5/28, p = 0.0515; 유일한 유의 결과는 Nolan의 7일째 통증 감소 p = 0.016); 비뚤림 위험 (Risk of Bias, RoB) 2 도구 기준 저위험 4편·일부 우려 3편. - 건강한 환자의 임플란트 수술에서 루틴 항생제 예방투여 비권고를 뒷받침 — 항균제 내성 (Antimicrobial Resistance, AMR) 방지 관점과 AFSSAPS 2011·EAO 2015·ITI 권고에 부합; 메타분석 없는 서술 종합·RoB 단일 평가자·데이터베이스 3개 검색(회색문헌 없음)이 한계.

Current Evidence on Celecoxib Safety in the Management of Chronic Musculoskeletal Conditions: An Umbrella Review
Beaudart C, Brabant C, Alokail M, Regins · 2025 sr+ma
This umbrella review included 16 systematic reviews (all based on randomized controlled trials) to evaluate celecoxib safety in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis, searching MEDLINE, Cochrane Central, and Scopus through November 2024. Celecoxib demonstrated superior gastrointestinal safety compared with non-selective NSAIDs, with a pooled risk ratio for gastroduodenal ulcers of 0.22 (95% CI 0.15–0.32, I² = 0%) from one high-quality meta-analysis; cardiovascular outcomes were generally similar to non-selective NSAIDs, although one meta-analysis showed reduced cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.75, 95% CI 0.57–0.99, p = 0.04) with celecoxib, and renal adverse events appeared lower with celecoxib than placebo (RR 0.79, 95% CI 0.66–0.94, p < 0.05).
이 총괄적 문헌고찰(umbrella review)은 16개의 체계적 문헌고찰(모두 무작위 대조 임상시험 기반)을 포함하여 골관절염(osteoarthritis, OA), 류마티스 관절염(rheumatoid arthritis, RA), 강직성 척추염(ankylosing spondylitis, AS)에서 셀레콕십(celecoxib)의 안전성을 평가했으며, 2024년 11월까지 MEDLINE, Cochrane Central, Scopus를 검색했습니다. 셀레콕십은 비선택성 비스테로이드성 항염증제(non-selective NSAIDs)보다 우수한 위장관 안전성을 보였으며, 하나의 고품질 메타분석에서 위십이지장 궤양(gastroduodenal ulcers)에 대한 통합 위험비(RR)는 0.22 (95% CI 0.15–0.32, I² = 0%)였습니다; 심혈관 결과는 비선택성 NSAID와 대체로 유사했으나, 한 메타분석에서 셀레콕십이 심혈관 사망률을 감소시켰고(RR 0.75, 95% CI 0.57–0.99, p = 0.04), 신장 이상반응은 셀레콕십에서 위약보다 낮았습니다(RR 0.79, 95% CI 0.66–0.94, p < 0.05).

Postoperative Analgesics·Pain Management Overview
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 55 papers (24 SR+MA/network MA, 3 SR, 10 RCTs, 2 retrospective cohorts, 10 narrative reviews, 6 guideline/consensus documents) on acute dental pain management, anchored by the 2024 ADA clinical practice guideline (Carrasco-Labra 2024, JADA 155:102-117) — the first systematically developed ADA guideline: nonopioid first-line (NSAID alone or + acetaminophen 500 mg) for all scenarios; opioids recommended AGAINST after simple extraction; optional opioid-combination second line reserved for rare inadequate control after surgical extraction (lowest dose, fewest tablets, rarely >3 days); corticosteroids recommended AGAINST as analgesic adjuncts (Conditional, Very Low) because their pooled pain reduction falls below a 10-point triviality threshold (Miroshnychenko 2023 SR, 40 RCTs) — anti-edema and anti-trismus use is out of scope.
치과 급성 통증 55편(SR+MA·Network MA 24·SR 3·RCT 10·후향 2·narrative 10·지침·합의 6) 통합: **2024 ADA 공식 CPG**(Carrasco-Labra 2024)가 최초 체계적 지침 — 전 시나리오 비오피오이드 1선(NSAID 단독 또는 + APAP 500mg); 단순 발치는 오피오이드 반대 권고, 외과 발치는 불충분 시에만 오피오이드 2선; 코르티코스테로이드 진통 보조는 반대 권고(통증 감소가 무의미 임계치 미만, Miroshnychenko 2023 SR; 부종·개구제한 목적은 범위 밖); ibuprofen 400mg + APAP 병용이 NNT ≈1.5 최강(Miroshnychenko 2023 NMA 82 RCT n=9,095).

Oral health-related quality of life following third molar surgery with either oral administration or submucosal injection of prednisolone
Ibikunle et al. · 2016 rct
Three-arm RCT (n=186, 62 per group) from a Nigerian tertiary hospital compared oral prednisolone 40 mg, submucosal injection prednisolone 40 mg, and no prednisolone in patients undergoing third molar surgery, using OHIP-14 as the primary outcome assessed at days 1, 3, and 7. Both prednisolone groups showed significantly better oral health-related quality of life than controls (p<0.05); submucosal injection produced significantly less QoL deterioration than oral administration (p=0.001). This is the largest RCT establishing OHIP-14 as primary endpoint for M3 corticosteroid research, and the positive QoL signal for prednisolone directly contrasts with Larsen 2021's null result for methylprednisolone, suggesting drug- or route-level differences warrant further investigation.
줄1: 나이지리아 3차 병원의 3군 무작위대조시험 (Randomized Controlled Trial, RCT) (n=186, 군당 62명)에서 경구 프레드니솔론 (Prednisolone) 40 mg, 점막하 주사 (Submucosal Injection) 40 mg, 무투여 대조군을 비교하여 구강건강관련 삶의 질 (Oral Health-Related Quality of Life, OHRQoL, OHIP-14)을 주요 결과 지표로 평가했다. 줄2: 프레드니솔론 투여군(경구·점막하 모두)은 미투여 대조군 대비 삶의 질이 유의하게 좋았으며(p<0.05), 점막하 주사군이 경구 투여군보다 삶의 질 저하가 유의하게 적었다(p=0.001). 줄3: OHIP-14를 주요 평가 지표로 삼은 최대 규모 RCT로, 프레드니솔론의 긍정적 삶의 질 신호는 라르센(Larsen) 2021의 메틸프레드니솔론 (Methylprednisolone) null 결과와 대비되어 약물·경로별 차이에 대한 추가 연구가 필요함을 시사한다.

Efficacy of methylprednisolone on pain, trismus and quality of life following surgical removal of mandibular third molars: a double-blind, split-mouth, randomised controlled trial
Larsen et al. · 2021 rct
Double-blind split-mouth RCT (n=52) conducted at Aalborg University Hospital (Denmark) compared intraoperative masseter IM injection of methylprednisolone 20, 30, or 40 mg vs placebo saline in patients with bilateral impacted mandibular third molars, with follow-up at days 1, 3, 7, and 30. No significant differences were detected between any methylprednisolone dose and placebo for pain (VAS), trismus (interincisal distance), or QoL (OHIP-14); increasing age and smoking combined with longer surgery duration were independently stronger predictors of worse outcomes (p=0.00). The null result across all three doses argues against routine methylprednisolone for postoperative morbidity reduction in third molar surgery, with patient factors appearing more clinically relevant than corticosteroid dosing.
줄1: 덴마크 알보르 대학병원의 이중맹검 분할구강 (Split-mouth) 무작위대조시험 (Randomized Controlled Trial, RCT) (n=52)에서 양측 하악 사랑니 발치 중 교근 (Masseter) 내 메틸프레드니솔론 (Methylprednisolone) 20/30/40 mg 또는 위약을 주사하고 1·3·7·30일 추적했다. 줄2: 어느 용량에서도 위약 대비 통증(시각통증척도, Visual Analog Scale, VAS)·개구제한 (Trismus)·삶의 질 (OHIP-14) 차이가 유의하지 않았으며, 나이 증가와 흡연+수술 시간이 더 강한 예후 인자였다(p=0.00). 줄3: 세 용량 모두 null 결과를 보여 용량 증가 가설을 지지하지 않으며, 사랑니 술후 이환율 감소를 위한 메틸프레드니솔론의 일상적 사용에 의문을 제기한다.

Anticoagulation Use prior to Common Dental Procedures: A Systematic Review
Johnny Chahine et al. · 2019 sr
Systematic review of 10 clinical trials (5 RCT, 5 CCT, n=1,331) comparing continued, interrupted, and heparin-bridged anticoagulation across multiple common dental procedures including extraction, implant surgery, and periodontal surgery. Continuing VKA or NOAC did not increase post-operative bleeding in most trials, whereas heparin bridging was consistently associated with higher bleeding incidence; no thromboembolic events were reported in any study. The authors recommend maintaining oral anticoagulation for the vast majority of dental procedures combined with local hemostatic agents; evidence is limited to PubMed (1996–2016) with no meta-analysis possible due to heterogeneity.
줄1: 체계적 문헌고찰 (Systematic Review, SR) 10편 (무작위대조시험 (Randomized Controlled Trial, RCT) 5편·비무작위 대조시험 (Controlled Clinical Trial, CCT) 5편, n=1,331): 발치·임플란트·치주수술 등 치과 시술 전반에서 항응고제 (Anticoagulant) 유지·중단·헤파린 브리징 (Heparin Bridging) 전략 비교. 줄2: 대부분의 시험에서 비타민K길항제 (Vitamin K Antagonist, VKA)·신형경구항응고제 (Novel Oral Anticoagulant, NOAC) 유지 시 술후 출혈 증가 없음; 헤파린 브리징은 출혈 증가와 일관되게 연관; 전 연구에서 혈전색전증 (Thromboembolism) 사례 없음. 줄3: 대다수 치과 시술에서 경구항응고제 (Oral Anticoagulant, OAC) 유지+국소 지혈제 사용 권고; 검색을 PubMed로만 제한하고 이질성으로 메타분석 (Meta-analysis) 불가한 점이 한계.

🟡 조건부 반박oral-surgery/nerve-injury
Mandibular Unilateral Paresthesia Following Implant Placement and Clinical Management: Clinical Case Report
Baskaran S et al. · 2024 case-report
This case report describes a 65-year-old male patient with a two-year history of right lower lip paresthesia and occasional drooling following implant placement in the right mandibular first molar region (tooth 46). Clinical and radiological examination with cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) confirmed the implant apex resting on the inferior alveolar nerve canal. Surgical retrieval of the well-osseointegrated implant resulted in complete neurosensory recovery within six weeks, after which the edentulous site was restored with a provisional three-unit fixed partial denture.
본 증례보고는 우측 하악 제1대구치(46번) 부위에 임플란트 식립 후 2년간 우측 하순 지속성 감각저하와 가끔씩 침 흘림을 호소한 65세 남성 환자를 기술한다. 콘빔 컴퓨터단층촬영(CBCT)을 포함한 임상 및 방사선 검사에서 임플란트 첨단이 하치조신경관에 접촉되어 있음이 확인되었다. 골유착이 잘 된 임플란트를 외과적으로 제거한 결과 6주 내에 신경감각이 완전히 회복되었으며, 이후 결손 부위는 임시 3유닛 고정성 국소의치로 수복되었다.

TMJ Disc Complex — Posterior Attachment Characterization (Donahue 2023)
Donahue RP, Kallins EG, Hu JC, Athanasio · 2023 animal
Structural, tensile, biochemical, and collagen-crosslinking characterization of the two posterior attachments (posterior superior attachment, PSA; posterior inferior attachment, PIA) and the lateral disc in the Yucatan minipig, a standard large-animal TMJ model. The PIA was 2.13× stiffer and 2.30× stronger than the PSA, 1.93× more collagenous by dry weight, and 1.78× more crosslinked; the PSA was the most heterogeneous and fattiest region, while the lateral disc had the highest glycosaminoglycan content (1.48–5.39× the attachments) and the most anisotropic collagen. The attachments are less fibrocartilaginous than the disc but still load-bearing, supporting a division of function — the stiffer PIA anchors the disc to the condyle during articulation while the softer PSA allows translation over the articular eminence. *(abstract-only — full text not retrieved.)*
턱관절 대동물 표준 모델인 유카탄 미니피그에서 두 후방 부착부(후상방 부착부 (PSA)·후하방 부착부 (PIA))와 외측 원판의 구조·인장·생화학·콜라겐 가교 (crosslinking)를 정량했다. PIA는 PSA보다 2.13배 뻣뻣하고 2.30배 강하며 건조중량당 콜라겐 1.93배·가교 1.78배 많았고, PSA는 가장 이질적이고 지방이 많았으며 외측 원판은 글리코사미노글리칸이 가장 높고(부착부의 1.48–5.39배) 콜라겐 이방성이 가장 컸다. 부착부는 원판보다 섬유연골성이 낮지만 여전히 하중을 견디며 — 뻣뻣한 PIA가 원판을 과두에 고정하고 무른 PSA가 원판의 관절융기 활주를 허용하는 기능 분담을 뒷받침한다. *(abstract-only — 전문 미확보.)*

Retrodiscal Tissue Tensile Biomechanics (Coombs 2017)
Coombs MC, Petersen JM, Wright GJ, Lu SH · 2017 animal
Ex-vivo tensile biomechanics study of 20 porcine retrodiscal-tissue (RDT) specimens (incremental stress-relaxation, 5–50% strain) with second-harmonic-generation (SHG) microscopy of collagen and elastin. Young's modulus stayed <1 MPa from 5–20% strain and reached a maximum of only 2.9 MPa at 50% strain, with region- and strain-dependence (higher temporally and mediolaterally, p < 0.001); collagen was most organized near the disc boundary and progressively disorganized posteriorly. The very low tensile moduli indicate the RDT is not stiff enough to resist pathologic anterior disc displacement, challenging the classical "posterior brake" model of disc stability. *(abstract-only — full text not retrieved.)*
돼지 후방조직 (retrodiscal tissue, RDT) 20검체의 인장 생체역학 (점증적 응력완화, 5–50% 변형)을 제2고조파발생 (second-harmonic generation, SHG) 현미경 콜라겐·엘라스틴 영상과 함께 분석한 체외 연구다. 영률 (Young's modulus)은 5–20% 변형에서 <1 MPa, 50% 변형에서야 최대 2.9 MPa였고 부위·변형 의존적이었으며(측두골측·내외측에서 높음, p < 0.001), 콜라겐은 원판 경계부에서 가장 정렬되고 후방으로 갈수록 흐트러졌다. 매우 낮은 인장 계수는 RDT가 병적 전방 원판 변위를 저지할 만큼 뻣뻣하지 않음을 시사하며, 원판 안정성의 고전적 "후방 제동" 모델에 의문을 던진다. *(abstract-only — 전문 미확보.)*

Peri- and Intraarticular Injections with Isolable Treatment Effects in Recurrent Mandibular Dislocation: A Mapping Review of the Current Evidence
Amelia Hoppe, Maciej Checiński, Wojciech · 2026 sr
Mapping review (OSF-registered osf.io/p3tm5, PRISMA 2020 flow for visualisation only) of PubMed/MEDLINE, Europe PMC and BASE from inception to 7 April 2026, applying a deliberately restrictive rule that an injectable counts as evidence only when its clinical effect can be assessed **independently** of any simultaneous surgical, arthroscopic or immobilisation procedure — which reduced the entire field to **5 primary clinical studies plus 8 secondary sources** (231 records excluded at title/abstract; Cohen's κ = 0.89 and 0.92 at the two screening stages; JBI appraisal rating methodological quality generally low to moderate).

> [!summary] 한국어 핵심요약 > - 서술형 종설(narrative review) — 2023년 9월까지 PubMed·Web of Science·Scopus 키워드 검색, PRISMA·비뚤림위험 평가·메타분석 없음. > - 건선관절염(Psoriatic Arthritis, PsA)의 TMJ(측두하악관절) 침범을 다룸: 기전·진단소견·치료·성별차이(잠정적). > - 기전: HLA 연관(HLA-B27, HLA-Cw6, IL23R) + TNF-α/IL-17/IL-23 매개 활막 저산소증-혈관신생-미란 연쇄. > - 감별점: 부착부염(enthesitis)·증식성 골병변이 골관절염(중심부 미란만)·류마티스관절염(더 빠른 진행)과 다른 PsA 특이적 영상소견. > - **저자가 직접 인정**: TMJ 침범 역학자료는 "찾기 어렵다(hard to find)", 치료·삶의 질 연구도 소수. > - 치료 사다리: NSAIDs/스테로이드 → 메토트렉세이트 → 항TNF/IL-12·23/IL-17 생물학적제제 → 수술(난치성 중증에 한함). > - 성별차이 자료 대부분은 **PsA 일반**(TMJ 특이 아님) 또는 **TMD 일반**(PsA 특이 아님) 문헌의 외삽 — TMJ 특이적 성별-계층화 자료는 본문에 없음. > - 여성=축성(axial) 분포(척추·천장관절+TMJ가 이 범주에 묶임), 남성=말초관절 분포라는 서술은 PsA 일반 소견의 확장. > - 실무 결론: 류마티스내과·피부과·치과(가임기/임신 시 산부인과 포함) **다학제 협진 필요** — 건선 병력+신규 TMJ 증상은 스플린트 관찰이 아니라 의뢰 신호. > - 위키 상 68편 TMJ 논문 중 PsA를 다룬 첫 페이지 — 류마티스관절염·소아특발성관절염에 이은 세 번째 염증성 관절염 항목.

Cellular Basis of Retrodiscal Tissue Remodeling After Disc Displacement (Yuan 2026)
Yuan W, Chen Y, Yan R, Liu W, Wang C, Wa · 2026 animal
Porcine unilateral anterior disc displacement (ADD) model (Ni-Ti-spring elastic traction; 2 sham + 2 ADD pigs; single-cell RNA-seq of disc and retrodiscal tissue at 5 weeks; separate rat ADD model for drug testing) resolving the cellular basis of retrodiscal adaptive remodeling — the histologically known but mechanistically opaque conversion of loose connective tissue into load-bearing fibrocartilage. Both the ADD side and the untreated contralateral side remodeled (dense connective tissue + Alcian-blue+ cartilaginous masses replacing loose tissue and fat); a progenitor-like fibroblast subcluster (FB2) expanded and a new ECM-remodeling mural-cell subcluster (MC4, pericyte-derived) emerged, with MC4→FB2 paracrine FGF2 and BMP5 signaling driving fibrosis and chondrogenesis via sequential ERK1/2 then SMAD1/5/9 activation. Computational drug screening nominated zaprinast (PDE5 inhibitor / GPR35 agonist), which enhanced fibroblast ECM synthesis and chondrogenesis in vitro and reduced disc/retrodiscal deformation plus condylar cartilage and subchondral-bone loss in the rat ADD model — a conservative pharmacotherapy concept that promotes tissue adaptation rather than repositioning the disc.
돼지 편측 전방 원판 변위 (anterior disc displacement, ADD) 모델(Ni-Ti 스프링 탄성 견인; 대조 2 + ADD 2마리; 5주째 원판·후방조직 단일세포 RNA 시퀀싱 (scRNA-seq); 약물 검증용 랫드 ADD 모델 별도)로, 조직학적으로만 알려졌던 후방조직 (retrodiscal tissue) 적응성 재형성 — 성긴 결합조직이 하중을 견디는 섬유연골로 전환 — 의 세포 기전을 규명했다. ADD측·반대측(무처치) 모두에서 성긴 조직·지방이 치밀 결합조직과 Alcian blue 양성 연골성 덩어리로 대체되었고, 전구세포 유사 섬유아세포 아군집 FB2가 증식하고 혈관주위세포 유래 ECM 재형성 벽세포 아군집 MC4가 출현하여, MC4→FB2 방향의 FGF2·BMP5 곁분비 신호가 ERK1/2에 이어 SMAD1/5/9를 순차 활성화해 섬유화·연골화를 구동했다. 계산적 약물 스크리닝으로 zaprinast(PDE5 억제제 / GPR35 작용제)를 도출했고, 시험관 내에서 섬유아세포 ECM 합성·연골분화를 촉진하며 랫드 ADD 모델에서 원판·후방조직 변형과 과두 연골·연골하골 소실을 줄여 — 원판을 되돌리는 대신 조직 적응을 촉진하는 보존적 약물치료 개념을 제시한다.

synthesis
Synthesis of 9 studies (1 large ML retrospective, 1 adult retrospective, 4 cross-sectional including 2 pediatric, 2 reminder RCTs, and 1 systematic review): dental no-show rates are 42.7–52% (higher than primary-care medicine), driven by forgetfulness, scheduling conflicts, and parental behavior rather than cost **wherever a payer absorbs the fee** (44% non-attendance despite 85% insurance coverage, Khries 2024; highest-SES group had the highest rate, Bhatia 2018) — but where coverage is absent, cost and appointment availability were named by 100% of barrier-affected patients (Okyere Boadu 2025, Ghana).

Accuracy of artificial intelligence in orthodontic extraction treatment planning: a systematic review and meta analysis
Ziaei S, Samani D, Behjati M, Ravari AO, · 2025 sr+ma
SR+MA (PRISMA/PROSPERO CRD42024582455; search to 2 June 2025) of AI models predicting orthodontic extraction vs. non-extraction: 7 cross-sectional studies, 6 countries, 6,261 patients, graded against clinicians' actual extraction decisions as the reference standard.
> [!summary] 한국어 핵심요약 > - PRISMA/PROSPERO(CRD42024582455) 체계적 문헌고찰+메타분석(2025-06-02까지 검색): 교정 발치 여부를 예측하는 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence, AI) 모델 7편(6개국, 환자 6,261명, 전부 횡단면 연구). > - **기준(reference standard)은 임상의의 실제 발치 결정** — AI가 "정답"과 비교되는 것이 아니라 논쟁적인 인간의 판단과 비교된다. > - **통합 민감도(Sensitivity) 70%(95% CI 61–78)** — 발치가 필요한 환자 10명 중 약 **3명을 놓친다**는 뜻. 통합 특이도(Specificity) 90%(95% CI 87–92)로 비발치 확인은 잘하고 발치 검출은 약함 — 비대칭 실패 양상. > - 이질성(Heterogeneity) 극단적: I²=96.7%(민감도)·93.7%(특이도) — 통합치는 서로 다른 모델·데이터셋의 평균일 뿐 대표성이 낮음. > - 합성곱 신경망(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 기반 모델(ResNet·VGG)만 이질성 0%로 가장 높고 일관된 성능(민감도 0.758–0.824, 특이도 0.931–0.941) — 하위그룹 결과가 더 해석 가능함. > - 메타회귀분석: 발치 유병률이 민감도에 유의한 영향(p=0.050) — 훈련 데이터의 발치 비율이 높을수록 민감도가 높게 보고되는 경향, 일반화 가능성 우려. > - 깔때기그림(Funnel Plot) 비대칭 — 출판 편향 가능성 시사하나, 연구 7편은 이 검정을 신뢰하기엔 적은 수(관례상 ~10편 미만은 불안정). > - **저자 결론("정확도를 높이는 예측 모델로 사용 가능")은 이 수치가 뒷받침하지 못한다** — CI 하한 61%, 극단적 이질성, 발치 결정처럼 임상의도 서로 갈리는 판단(하한 근거: [[practice-management/dufey-portilla-2026-treatment-decision-making-apical-periodontitis-clinician-groups]])을 "정답"으로 삼은 근본적 한계. > - 전부 **횡단면 설계**만 — 전향적 검증·환자 예후 데이터 없음. > - 위키 내 대비: 같은 저자군 도메인의 **검출(detection)** 과제([[artificial-intelligence/alabdulkareem-2026-ai-dental-treatment-planning-decision-making-sr-ma]], 민감도 0.85)는 이 논문의 **결정(decision)** 과제(민감도 0.70)보다 뚜렷이 우수 — AI는 "본다"는 훨씬 잘하고 "결정한다"는 상대적으로 약함.

Physical, mechanical properties and accuracy of thermoformed vs 3D-printed aligners: systematic review and meta-analysis
Jorge JO et al. · 2026 sr+ma
- SR+MA (23 in vitro studies; 4 in meta-analysis) comparing physical, mechanical, and dimensional accuracy properties of thermoformed (TM) versus direct 3D-printed (DTP) clear aligners; all evidence in vitro with 0 low-risk-of-bias studies. - TM aligners showed higher flexural strength, storage modulus, and surface microhardness; DTP showed better shape recovery, greater vertical traction forces, superior geometric accuracy, and a lower glass-transition temperature (Tg = 42.3 °C); thickness variation meta-analysis was non-significant (SMD 1.48; p = .62; I² = 97%). - No universally superior technology exists: TM rigidity favors sustained force delivery while DTP geometric precision may benefit complex tooth movements; DTP's low Tg warrants caution with hot beverages; standardized in vitro and clinical comparison protocols are needed.
- SR+MA (23편 in vitro / 4편 메타): 성형 투명교정장치 (Thermoformed, TM) vs 직접 3D 출력 교정장치 (Direct 3D-Printed, DTP) 물리·기계·치수 정확도 비교; 전 근거 in vitro, 저비뚤림 연구 0편. - TM이 굴곡강도·저장탄성률·표면경도 우위; DTP가 형상회복능 (Shape Recovery)·수직 견인력·기하학적 정확도 (Geometric Accuracy) 우위, 유리전이온도 (Glass-Transition Temperature, Tg) 낮음 (42.3 °C); 두께 변화량 메타분석 유의차 없음 (I²=97%). - 범용 우월 기술 없음: TM은 지속 힘 전달, DTP는 복잡 이동 정밀도에 각각 유리; DTP 낮은 Tg — 열음료 주의 필요; 표준화된 임상 비교 연구 필요.

Orthodontically induced inflammatory root resorption in anterior teeth after treatment with clear aligners and fixed appliances, measured with cone-beam computed tomography: A systematic review and meta-analysis
Samulak R et al. · 2026 sr+ma
- SR+MA (4 high-quality CBCT cohort studies; 1,204 anterior teeth) comparing orthodontically induced inflammatory root resorption (OIIRR) between clear aligner and fixed appliance therapy using CBCT linear measurements. - Both groups showed statistically significant root resorption: clear aligner WMD −0.47 mm (95% CI −0.55 to −0.40) versus fixed appliance WMD −0.54 mm (95% CI −0.75 to −0.33); the between-group difference was statistically significant (p<0.01), most pronounced in non-extraction maxillary central incisors; absolute difference ~0.07 mm. - Clear aligners cause significantly less anterior OIIRR and are preferable for elevated-OIIRR-risk patients (thin/short roots, prior resorption history); the modest absolute difference (0.07 mm) does not justify treatment selection changes in average-risk cases.
- SR+MA (CBCT 코호트 4편/1,204 전치): CBCT 선형 계측으로 투명교정 (Clear Aligner) vs 고정식 교정장치에서 교정유발 치근염증성 흡수 (Orthodontically Induced Inflammatory Root Resorption, OIIRR) 비교. - 두 군 모두 유의한 치근 흡수: CA WMD −0.47 mm (95% CI −0.55~−0.40) vs 고정식 −0.54 mm (95% CI −0.75~−0.33); 군 간 차이 유의 (p<0.01); 비발치 상악 중절치 (Maxillary Central Incisor) 에서 가장 두드러짐; 절대 차이 약 0.07 mm. - CA가 전치 OIIRR을 유의하게 덜 유발하며 고위험 환자 (세장·단근·기왕 흡수력)에 선호 술식; 절대차 미미 — 평균 위험 환자에서 술식 선택 기준으로는 불충분.

This RCT compared external apical root resorption (EARR) on incisors after non-extraction Class I malocclusion treatment using clear aligners (n=15) vs fixed appliances (n=17) with novel 3D AI-based CBCT surface analysis. Overall median EARR was −0.72 mm with no significant difference between groups; upper lateral incisors showed significantly greater EARR than lower incisors (p=0.002) and upper central incisors (p<0.001). No significant predictor was found for age, sex, crowding severity, or treatment duration.

CBCT-Based Assessment of External Apical Root Resorption in Clear Aligner Versus Fixed Orthodontic Therapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
Yıldırım E, Topbas C · 2026 sr+ma
- PROSPERO-registered SR+MA (CRD420261320269; 6 CBCT-exclusive comparative studies; 392 patients) comparing external apical root resorption (EARR) in clear aligner versus fixed orthodontic appliance groups using only quantitative CBCT linear measurements. - Pooled random-effects meta-analysis yielded MD = −0.50 mm (95% CI −0.79 to −0.21; p<0.001; I²=60.8%) favoring clear aligners; non-extraction/mixed subgroup (k=5) MD = −0.41 mm; leave-one-out sensitivity confirmed robustness (−0.41 to −0.60 mm); GRADE certainty low. - Clear aligner therapy produces statistically significantly less apical root shortening than fixed appliances on CBCT measurement; the effect is robust to sensitivity analysis but GRADE-low certainty from non-randomized designs means this evidence is exploratory rather than clinically definitive.
- SR+MA (PROSPERO CRD420261320269; CBCT 전용 비교연구 6편; 392명): 투명교정 (Clear Aligner) vs 고정식 교정장치 간 외부 치근단 흡수 (External Apical Root Resorption, EARR) — CBCT 선형 계측만 포함. - 메타분석 MD = −0.50 mm (95% CI −0.79~−0.21; p<0.001; I²=60.8%) CA 우위; 비발치/혼합 하위군 (k=5) MD = −0.41 mm; 민감도 분석 (Leave-one-out) 일관성 확인 (−0.41~−0.60 mm); 근거 확실도 (GRADE) 낮음. - CA가 CBCT 계측에서 통계적으로 유의하게 적은 치근단 흡수 유발; 효과 일관되나 비무작위 설계로 GRADE 낮음 — 탐색적 근거로 해석 권장.

Predictability of Lower Incisor Intrusion with Clear Aligners: A Systematic Review of Efficacy and Influencing Factors
Fracchia DE et al. · 2025 sr
- Systematic review (8 clinical studies, PRISMA, 5 databases) specifically evaluating predictability of lower incisor intrusion with clear aligners in permanent dentition. - Mean intrusion achieved 0.4–1.5 mm with predictability 35–65% across studies; 7/8 studies had serious risk of bias by ROBINS-I; GRADE certainty moderate to low; four key moderating factors: movement magnitude, auxiliaries (attachments/elastics), refinement strategies, and patient-specific factors (age, compliance). - Lower incisor intrusion with clear aligners consistently underperforms planned correction; attachments, elastics, and planned overcorrection are necessary clinical adjustments; long-term stability data remain absent.
- SR (8개 임상 연구, PRISMA, 5개 데이터베이스): 영구치열에서 투명교정 (Clear Aligner) 하악 전치 압하 (Lower Incisor Intrusion) 예측도 (Predictability) 전용 평가. - 달성 압하량 0.4–1.5 mm, 예측도 35–65%; 7/8 연구 심각한 비뚤림 위험 (ROBINS-I); 근거 확실도 (GRADE) 중-저; 이동 크기·보조장치 (어태치먼트·탄성)·리파인먼트 (Refinement)·환자 요인이 주요 조절 변수. - 투명교정 하악 전치 압하는 계획량 달성에 일관되게 미달; 어태치먼트·탄성·과교정 계획 필수; 장기 안정성 데이터 부재.

Effectiveness and accuracy of clear aligners in treatment of deep bite: a systematic review
Husain F et al. · 2025 sr
- Systematic review (18 studies, PROSPERO CRD42022334078, databases inception to May 2024) evaluating effectiveness and accuracy of clear aligners for dental and skeletal deep bite correction across all age groups. - Effectiveness (achieved bite opening) ranged 0.4–3.8 mm; accuracy (achieved vs planned) ranged 33–48.88%; GRADE evidence quality rated low due to high risk of bias, indirectness, and imprecision; primary mechanism was anterior intrusion with or without posterior extrusion. - Clear aligners are effective for mild to moderate dentoalveolar deep bites but their efficacy for skeletal cases versus fixed appliances remains uncertain; systematic overcorrection or refinement planning is required to achieve target outcomes.
- SR (18개 연구, PROSPERO CRD42022334078, 2024년 5월까지): 전 연령 치조성·골격성 깊은교합 (Deep Bite) 교정에서 투명교정 (Clear Aligner) 효과 및 정확도 평가. - 효과 (교합 거상량) 0.4–3.8 mm; 정확도 (계획 대비 달성 비율) 33–48.88%; 근거 확실도 (GRADE) 저급 (높은 비뚤림·간접성·부정확성); 주 기전은 전치 압하 (Anterior Intrusion) ± 구치 정출 (Posterior Extrusion). - 경-중등도 치조성 깊은교합에 유효하나 골격성 증례에서 고정식 대비 우위 불확실; 목표 결과 달성을 위해 과교정 계획 또는 리파인먼트 필수.

Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 24 papers (2 umbrella meta-analyses, 3 SR+MAs, 1 long-term prospective cohort, 2 expert consensus statements, 1 SR, 1 narrative): keratinized mucosa width (KMW) ≥2 mm is the agreed threshold across all evidence tiers; inadequate KM is most strongly and consistently linked to soft-tissue surrogates (plaque OR 2.78 TSA-confirmed; inflammation eOR 3.13–5.34; recession eOR 4.05; Mahardawi 2023 SR+MA, 22 studies, 13,265 implants; Sabri 2025 umbrella); the link to peri-implantitis incidence (OR 2.78) and marginal bone loss (MD −0.27 mm, Zhang 2025) is directionally consistent but TSA-underpowered or heterogeneous (I²=80–97%).

치과 직접충전재 발달사 — Silicate·Amalgam에서 Composite·Glass Ionomer·Bioactive까지 (Overview)
Synthesis · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of the wiki's material-science and clinical pages tracing direct dental restorative history along three intertwined lineages: the esthetic line (silicate → PMMA → Bowen's Bis-GMA 1962 + acid-etch → light-curing via camphorquinone/LED → low-shrinkage monomers → bulk-fill → bioactive resins); the posterior-durability line (amalgam's ~century dominance with median survival >16 years, phased out by the Minamata Convention on mercury, not by performance inferiority — 5-year Cochrane SR and SR+MA both show composite ≈ amalgam survival); and the fluoride/bioactive line (GIC's chemical adhesion + fluoride release, WHO 2021 Essential Medicines listing, HVGIC for ART, alkasite, bioactive composites).
위키의 재료과학·임상 페이지를 종합해 직접충전재 역사를 세 계보로 정리: 심미선(silicate→PMMA→Bowen Bis-GMA 1962+산부식→광중합 CQ/LED→저수축 단량체→bulk-fill→bioactive resin); 구치부 내구선(아말감 생존 중앙값 >16년, 미나마타 협약 수은규제에 의한 퇴장, 5년 Cochrane SR·SR+MA 모두 복합레진≈아말감 생존율); 불소·생리활성선(GIC 화학접착+불소유리, 2021 WHO 필수의약품 등재, HVGIC ART, alkasite, bioactive composite).

Updates on the clinical application of glass ionomer cement in restorative and preventive dentistry
Kelsey Xingyun Ge, Walter Yu-Hang Lam, C · 2024 narrative-review
Narrative review (J Dent Sci 2024) updating the clinical evidence for GIC (CGIC, HVGIC, RMGIC) across restorative and preventive dentistry applications following WHO's 2021 Essential Medicines listing and the Minamata Convention's amalgam phase-down.

Sinus Lift Complications — Xenograft Migration · Foreign-Body Sinusitis · Ostium Obstruction · BPPV
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 6 papers on maxillary sinus-floor-augmentation complications across 3 axes — graft (bovine xenograft) migration/foreign-body sinusitis, ostium obstruction, and BPPV: bovine xenograft (ABB/Bio-Oss) is **effectively non-biodegradable in humans** (particles intact at 10–20+ years), so it migrates — into the peri-implant sulcus in all 7/7 of Nowzari 2022's cases (2 mo–6 yr, mostly subclinical) or into the sinus, causing late complications years out (Rodriguez 2019: latency 2–13 yr; 13-yr sinusitis with 80% opacification, first reported bovine-bone cyst) whose definitive treatment is surgical removal, not repeat xenograft.
상악동거상술(MSFA) 합병증 3축(이식재 이동·이물 부비동염 / 배출구 폐쇄 / BPPV)을 6편으로 종합: 소뼈 이종골(Bio-Oss)은 인체서 사실상 비흡수라 10–20년 뒤에도 이동 — Nowzari 7/7 임플란트 주위 열구 이동(대부분 무증상), Rodriguez 후기(2–13년) 합병증(13년째 부비동염 CT 80% 혼탁·소뼈 낭종 첫 보고), 치료는 외과적 제거(재이종골 아닌 자가골).

The long-term risks and complications of bovine-derived xenografts: A case series
Rodriguez AE, Nowzari H · 2019 case-report
Case series (5 patients, private-practice referral cohort, 2 to 13 years after bovine-derived xenograft bone augmentation — mostly maxillary sinus lift and extraction-socket grafting) documenting late clinical complications of anorganic bovine bone (ABB) graft material.
증례군 연구 (환자 5명, 개인 클리닉 의뢰 코호트, 소 유래 이종골이식재 (Bovine-derived Xenograft) 식립 후 2-13년 경과 — 대부분 상악동거상술 및 발치와 이식) — 탈단백우골 (Anorganic Bovine Bone, ABB) 이식재의 후기 임상 합병증을 기술.

Socket Healing Biology & ARP Critical Appraisal — when not to graft
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis (counterpoint to the do-ARP protocol-ladder page) across 5 axes — socket healing biology, ARP critical appraisal (when NOT to graft), post-ARP implant failure predictors, adjunct materials, and beyond-ARP scenarios: post-extraction buccal resorption is biologically inevitable (bundle-bone dependence; Araujo 2005 dog histology), ~50% of buccolingual width lost by 1 year with 2/3 occurring in the first 3 months (Schropp 2003 prospective).
발치와 자연 치유 생물학 + ARP 한계·과잉치료 비판 5축 종합 — do-ARP 페이지의 대응쌍: 협측골 흡수는 다발골(bundle bone) 의존으로 생물학적 불가피(Araujo 2005), 협설폭 1년 ~50% 감소의 2/3이 첫 3개월 발생(Schropp 2003).
VS
Bone Regeneration — ARP & GBR Protocol Ladder
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis decomposing the post-extraction alveolar ridge preservation (ARP) decision into a 4-axis protocol ladder: untreated sockets lose ≈−3.79 mm horizontal width (29–63%) and ≈−1.24 to −1.67 mm buccal vertical height at 6 months with horizontal loss dominant (Tan 2012, Vanderweijden 2009, Couso-Queiruga 2021 SRs); ARP reduces horizontal resorption by ≈1.86–2.19 mm vs natural healing (Bassir 2018, Troiano 2018 SR+MAs), making ARP first-line when immediate placement is not possible.
치조제 보존술 (Alveolar Ridge Preservation, ARP) 4축 결정 ladder 종합 — 자연 치유 흡수(수평 −3.79mm, 수직 −1.24~1.67mm, 6개월; 수평 우세), ARP 효과(수평 1.86–2.19mm 감소), 이식재 비교, 차폐막·연조직봉쇄 조합.

즉시 상아질 밀봉 (Immediate Dentin Sealing, IDS) 근거 종합 — in-vitro 강함 vs 임상 POS 논쟁
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 8 IDS papers showing a two-tier evidence split: in-vitro bond-strength benefit is strong and consistent (Hardan 2022 SR+MA of 21 studies: IDS > delayed dentin sealing; Magne 2005: IDS 58 MPa vs DDS 12 MPa; provisional period up to 12 weeks with bond preserved; Abo-Alazm 2022: universal adhesive + physiologic pulp pressure confirmed), with 3-step etch-and-rinse or adhesive+flowable maximizing the effect and MDP-containing universals preferred.
8편 종합 — 근거가 2층으로 갈림: ①**in-vitro 결합강도**는 강하고 일관됨(Hardan 2022 SR+MA 21편: IDS > DDS; Magne 2005: IDS 58 MPa vs DDS 12 MPa; 임시보철 12주까지 결합 보존(Magne 2007); Abo-Alazm 2022: 생리적 치수압+universal 접착제 조건 확인) — 효과 최대는 3-step E&R 또는 접착제+flowable, MDP-함유 universal 우선.

Biomimetic Restorative Dentistry: an evidence-based discussion of common myths
Alessandra Reis, Victor Pinheiro Feitosa · 2024 narrative-review
Critical narrative review (Reis/Loguercio group, J Appl Oral Sci 2024) evaluating 9 biomimetic restorative dentistry (BRD) protocols against RCT/SR-level evidence via PubMed/Embase/Cochrane search; identifies cognitive biases (novelty, authority) driving adoption of unvalidated techniques.
Reis/Loguercio 그룹의 생체모방 수복치의학(Biomimetic Restorative Dentistry, BRD) 비판적 내러티브 리뷰(J Appl Oral Sci 2024): PubMed/Embase/Cochrane CENTRAL에서 9개 BRD 프로토콜별 RCT·SR 검색; 신규성·권위편향이 도입 동인임을 지목.

Cracked Tooth Syndrome — 분류·진단·치료 결정의 2026 종합 (Korean Clinical Application)
synthesis page (compiled by Claude; last · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of ~32 papers building a classification, diagnosis, and treatment-decision map for Cracked Tooth Syndrome: CTS is the incomplete-fracture entry within the 5-type longitudinal-fracture spectrum (craze line → fractured cusp → cracked tooth → split tooth → vertical root fracture), now anchored by the ESE consensus statement (Patel 2025) which recommends retiring the "CTS" label; diagnosis requires a multi-modal framework with now-quantified accuracies — transillumination sensitive but specificity only 53.6%, microscope/macrophotography specificity ~93%, QLF kappa 0.66–0.74, AI panoramic CNN AUC 0.82 for VRF screening.
~32편 종합: CTS는 종방향 파절 5-type(craze line → fractured cusp → cracked tooth → split tooth → VRF) 중 incomplete fracture 항목 — ESE Patel 2025 합의문이 표준 용어 확정 및 "CTS" 라벨 폐기 권고; 진단은 multi-modal framework 필수(정량 정확도: 투조 특이도 53.6%, 현미경 특이도 93%, QLF κ 0.66–0.74, AI AUC 0.82).

Ex vivo investigation on the effect of minimally invasive endodontic treatment on vertical root fracture resistance and crack formation
Rathke A, Frehse H, Bechtold M · 2024 in-vitro
Ex vivo factorial study (n=18/group, 6 groups, extracted human maxillary central incisors) comparing minimally invasive (#40/.04) vs conventional (ISO #80) canal shaping crossed with cement vs adhesive resin sealer, using chewing-simulation fatigue loading then load-to-fracture.
발치된 상악 중절치를 이용한 요인설계 ex vivo 연구(그룹당 n=18, 6군): 최소침습 근관성형(MIE, #40/.04) vs 기존 확대(ISO #80)와 시멘트·접착 레진 실러를 교차하여 저작 시뮬레이션 피로부하 후 파절강도 비교.

레진-상아질 결합 내구성·열화(Resin-Dentin Bond Durability & Degradation) 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 19 resin-bonding wiki papers across 7 axes of bond-degradation research: bonds fail via two parallel mechanisms — hydrolysis of hydrophilic resin (solvent-phase, thermodynamically driven) and MMP/cysteine-cathepsin collagenolysis of the water-rich, resin-sparse hybrid layer — with residual water as the shared culprit, visualized by nanoleakage silver-tracer and Tay–Pashley water-tree morphology (Tay 2003 ×2, Tay 2005).
위키 19편 7축 종합: 레진-상아질 결합 열화의 두 기전은 친수성 수지의 가수분해(hydrolysis)와 물이 많고 수지가 적은 혼성층(hybrid layer) 콜라겐의 기질금속단백분해효소(Matrix Metalloproteinase, MMP)/카텝신(cathepsin) 분해이며, 공통 원흉은 잔류 물(residual water) — 형태학적으로 나노누출(nanoleakage)·수분수(water-tree, Tay 2003·2005)로 나타남.
VS
Clinical performance of the ethanol-wet bonding technique with different adhesive systems in noncarious cervical lesion restorations: a 6-year randomized clinical trial
Luana dos Santos Souza, Maria Fernanda M · 2026 rct
Double-blind RCT (Clin Oral Investig 2026, Brazil): 148 NCCLs in 67 adults randomized to water-wet 3-step E&R control (NE) or ethanol-wet bonding (EWBT, 100% ethanol 60 s) with 3-step E&R (EMP), hydrophobic bond only (EB), or universal adhesive (EU); followed 6 years (72–83 months).
이중맹검 RCT(브라질): 성인 67명의 비우식성 치경부 병소 (Non-Carious Cervical Lesion, NCCL) 148개를 수분 습윤 3단계 산부식-수세 (Etch-and-Rinse, E&R) 대조군(NE) 또는 에탄올 습윤 접착술 (Ethanol-Wet Bonding Technique, EWBT) + 3단계 E&R(EMP)·소수성 본드 단독(EB)·유니버설 접착제(EU)로 배정, 6년(72–83개월) 추적.

A randomized clinical trial evaluating the success rate of ethanol wet bonding technique and two adhesives
Vajihesadat Mortazavi et al. · 2012 rct
1-year RCT (Dent Res J 2012; 36 NCCLs in 12 patients, Isfahan, Iran) comparing three adhesive strategies for cervical restorations: OptiBond FL (3-step etch-and-rinse), Clearfil SE Bond (2-step self-etch), and ethanol wet bonding (EWB) using the OptiBond FL adhesive component.

High Insertion Torque → Primary Stability, Crestal Bone Remodeling, and Marginal Bone Loss — A Conflict Synthesis
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Five papers on high insertion torque (IT) that appear to disagree — Trisi 2011 (sheep split-mouth histology, 40 implants, 110 vs 10 Ncm), Marconcini 2018 (RCT, 116 healed-site single implants, 3 y), Aldahlawi 2018 (retrospective, 113 NobelActive), Faot 2019 (prospective, 62 narrow ø2.9 mm implants in atrophic edentulous mandibles, 1 y), and Lemos 2020 (SR+MA, 6 studies / 651 implants) — resolve once IT is read not as an applied dose but as a *readout of the bone that resisted it*; a sixth paper, Coyac 2019 (rat, assigned misfit), was added on 2026-07-17 and supplies the compression-harm pathway the original five lacked.
고삽입토크(IT) 5편은 서로 어긋나 보이지만 — Trisi 2011(양 분할구강 조직학, 40개, 110 vs 10 Ncm), Marconcini 2018(RCT, 치유부위 단일 116개, 3년), Aldahlawi 2018(후향, NobelActive 113개), Faot 2019(전향, 위축 무치악 하악 세경 ø2.9mm 62개, 1년), Lemos 2020(SR+MA, 6편/651개) — IT를 *투여한 용량*이 아니라 *저항한 골을 읽은 값*으로 보면 정합적으로 풀린다. 2026-07-17에 6번째로 Coyac 2019(쥐, 미스핏 배정)가 추가돼, 5편에 없던 **압축→해악의 생물학적 경로**를 공급한다.
VS
A preclinical model links osseo-densification due to misfit and osseo-destruction due to stress/strain
Coyac BR, Leahy B, Salvi G, Hoffmann W, · 2019 animal
Preclinical in vivo animal study (rat maxillary extraction sockets; control = minimal implant–osteotomy misfit vs test = high misfit that osseo-densified the peri-implant bone), designed to link misfit, insertion torque, and implant stability to their short- and longer-term effects on peri-implant bone — the only held paper besides Trisi 2011 that *assigns* the mechanical exposure rather than binning it post-hoc.
전임상 생체 내 동물실험 (쥐 상악 발치와; 대조군 = 임플란트–골삭제 간 최소 미스핏(misfit) vs 시험군 = 주위골을 골밀도화 (Osseodensification, OD)시키는 고도 미스핏) — 미스핏·삽입 토크 (Insertion Torque, IT)·임플란트 안정성이 주위골에 미치는 단기·장기 효과를 연결하는 설계이며, 보유 논문 중 Trisi 2011과 함께 노출을 **사후 분류가 아니라 실험적으로 배정한** 단 두 편 중 하나다.

Clinical Effect of the High Insertion Torque on Dental Implants: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
Lemos CAA et al. · 2020 sr+ma
Systematic review and meta-analysis (6 studies, 389 patients, 651 implants) comparing dental implants placed with high insertion torque (삽입 토크, IT ≥50 Ncm) versus regular or low IT (<50 Ncm), with outcome measures of survival rate and marginal bone loss.

고삽입토크(IT) 5편은 서로 어긋나 보이지만 — Trisi 2011(양 분할구강 조직학, 40개, 110 vs 10 Ncm), Marconcini 2018(RCT, 치유부위 단일 116개, 3년), Aldahlawi 2018(후향, NobelActive 113개), Faot 2019(전향, 위축 무치악 하악 세경 ø2.9mm 62개, 1년), Lemos 2020(SR+MA, 6편/651개) — IT를 *투여한 용량*이 아니라 *저항한 골을 읽은 값*으로 보면 정합적으로 풀린다. 2026-07-17에 6번째로 Coyac 2019(쥐, 미스핏 배정)가 추가돼, 5편에 없던 **압축→해악의 생물학적 경로**를 공급한다.

임플란트 안정성 지수 (Implant Stability Quotient, ISQ) 부하 결정 임계값 — Confidence 등급별 매트릭스
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Cross-category synthesis of 27 ISQ-citing wiki pages: the robust loading threshold is ISQ <70 risky / ≥70 safe (Andersson 2019, n=745, 5y CSR 97.3%); immediate loading additionally requires insertion torque (IT) ≥35 Ncm alongside ISQ ≥70 (Wittneben 2023 SR); early loading at 6–8 weeks is supported when IT >40 Ncm alone (Andreatta 2020); the 60–70 gray zone requires per-case monitoring rather than automatic delay.
ISQ 인용 27편 횡단 합성: 부하 결정 임계값은 <70 위험·≥70 안전(Andersson 2019, n=745, 5년 CSR 97.3%); 즉시부하는 ISQ ≥70 + IT ≥35 Ncm 양조건 충족 필요(Wittneben 2023 SR); 6–8주 조기부하는 IT >40 Ncm 단독으로 가능(Andreatta 2020); 60–70 회색지대는 자동 지연이 아닌 개별 모니터링.

Penicillin Allergy Countermeasures in Dentistry — The Label, the Cross-Reactivity Myth, and the Fall of Clindamycin
Synthesis (LLM Wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 17 wiki papers (2 consensus statements, 3 SR+MA, 3 SR, 3 narrative reviews, 4 retrospective/cross-sectional microbiology and pharmacoepidemiology datasets) on how dentistry should handle the penicillin-allergic patient: the operative problem is the **allergy label**, not the allergy — roughly 10% of the population carries one, 80–99% of self-reported labels are disproved on testing, and the reflex substitution the label triggers is now the larger hazard.
위키 17편(합의문 2·체계적문헌고찰+메타분석 3·체계적문헌고찰 3·내러티브리뷰 3·후향/단면 미생물·약물역학 자료 4)을 종합: 치과에서 페니실린 알레르기 환자의 실제 1차 문제는 알레르기가 아니라 **알레르기 라벨**이다 — 인구의 약 10%가 보유하나 자가보고 라벨의 80–99%는 검사에서 부정되며, 그 라벨이 촉발하는 반사적 대체 처방이 더 큰 위해가 되었다.
VS

메타분석 없는 체계적 문헌고찰(Medline + Web of Science, PRISMA, JBI 평가) — 5편(관찰코호트 4·후향적 환자대조 1)으로 페니실린 알레르기 환자(클린다마이신)와 비알레르기 환자(아목시실린)의 조기 임플란트 실패 비교.

Antibiotics in Endodontics: a review
J. J. Segura-Egea, K. Gould, B. Hakan Şe · 2017 narrative-review
Narrative review synthesizing 60+ studies and multiregional European prescribing surveys on antibiotic indications in endodontic patient management. Antibiotics are ineffective for symptomatic irreversible pulpitis, pulp necrosis, and localized acute apical abscess; drainage/debridement is the sole primary intervention. Amoxicillin is first-line for odontogenic infections with systemic spread; clindamycin for penicillin-allergic patients; 40–86% of European dentists were inappropriately prescribing at the time of review.
근관치료 환자의 항생제 지시에 관한 60여 논문·유럽 다국가 처방 설문을 종합한 내러티브 리뷰. 증상성 불가역성 치수염 (Symptomatic Irreversible Pulpitis, SIP)·치수괴사·국소화된 급성 근첨 농양 (Acute Apical Abscess, AAA)에는 항생제 무효; 배농이 1차 중재. 아목시실린 (Amoxicillin)이 치성감염 (Odontogenic Infection) 1차약; 페니실린 과민 시 클린다마이신 (Clindamycin); 유럽 치과의사의 40–86%가 금기 상황에서 항생제를 처방한 것으로 보고됨.

치아 마모 수복공간 확보 — Dahl · VDO 거상 · 치관연장: 네 개의 축과 근거 경사 (Tooth Wear: Creating Restorative Space)
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 10 papers on how restorative space is created in the worn dentition, organized around a diagnostic inversion: the first question is not *how much* to raise the occlusal vertical dimension (OVD) but *whether the OVD was ever lost* — wear does not equal loss of vertical dimension, and space can be won on four distinct axes (incisal via the Dahl concept, whole-arch via semi-additive VDO increase, apical via crown lengthening, and orthodontic intrusion), whose evidence gradient inverts clinical intuition.
마모 치열에서 수복공간을 어떻게 얻는가에 대한 10편 종합 — 진단의 전환이 핵심: 첫 질문은 고경(OVD)을 *얼마나* 올릴까가 아니라 고경이 *상실되긴 했는가*다. 마모 ≠ 고경 상실이며, 공간은 네 축(절단연=Dahl, 전악=반부가형 거상, 근단=치관연장술, 교정적 압하)에서 얻을 수 있고 그 근거 경사는 임상 직관을 뒤집는다.

Novel Management for Severe Odontogenic Maxillary Sinusitis Based on Pathophysiology
Ohyama Y, Ogawa M, Yokoo S · 2022 case-report
Single case report (n=1, 54-year-old man) of severe odontogenic maxillary sinusitis (OMS) from underfilled teeth #25/#26 spreading to the frontal sinus, refractory to endodontic re-treatment and long-term antibiotics.
증례보고 (n=1, 54세 남성): 근관충전 불량 #25/#26에서 전두동까지 파급된 중증 치성 상악동염 (Odontogenic Maxillary Sinusitis, OMS) — 재근관치료 및 장기 항생제 무효.
🟡 조건부 반박overviews
투명교정 어태치먼트 종합 — 재료·전달 정확도·이동유형별 기여·대구치 원심이동
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
This overview synthesizes the held evidence on clear-aligner composite attachments — six attachment-dedicated papers (2 SRs, 1 SR+MA, 2 single-model FEA studies, 1 split-mouth RCT) plus seven supporting papers on attachment-dependent extrusion, rotation accuracy, resin/substrate bonding, FEA mechanics, attachment-margin demineralization, and scan fidelity. The consistent signal is that attachment *presence* improves movement expression and retention (and is a precondition for extrusion), while attachment *type* (optimized vs conventional) has not shown a clinical accuracy advantage, and neither type reaches the planned movement. Material choice between conventional and bulk-fill flowable composites does not change clinical survival (18.75% overall failure over 140 days, molars worse), but design and material recommendations above that level rest mostly on in-vitro and single-model FEA evidence.
투명교정 어태치먼트(Composite Attachment) 근거를 종합 — 어태치먼트 전용 6편(SR 2·SR+MA 1·단일모델 FEA 2·split-mouth RCT 1)에 정출·회전 정확도·레진/보철물 접착·FEA 기전·어태치먼트 주위 탈회·스캔 정확도 관련 보조 7편을 더했다. 일관된 신호는 어태치먼트의 **존재**가 이동 발현과 유지력을 높이고 정출의 전제조건이라는 것이며, **종류**(최적화형 vs 재래형)는 임상 정확도 우위가 없고 둘 다 계획 이동량에 못 미친다. 일반 vs 벌크필 플로어블 레진은 임상 생존율이 같지만(140일 탈락률 18.75%, 구치부 불리), 그 이상의 설계·재료 권고는 대부분 in-vitro·단일모델 FEA에 기대고 있다.
VS
Attachments for the Orthodontic Aligner Treatment—State of the Art—A Comprehensive Systematic Review
Maciej Jedliński, Marta Mazur, Mario Gre · 2023 sr
This comprehensive SR analyzed 26 articles on composite attachments for aligner treatment, covering attachment bonding (4 studies) and movement efficacy (22 studies). Attachments significantly improve orthodontic movement expression and aligner retention, with specific tooth sites identified for optimal efficacy by movement type. The review provides evidence-based guidance on attachment placement, shape, and bonding protocols.
투명교정 부착물의 형태·배치·접착에 대한 26편의 종합 SR로, 접착(4편)과 이동 효율(22편)을 분석. 부착물은 교정 이동 표현과 교정기 보존을 유의하게 향상시키며, 이동 유형별 최적 치아 위치가 확인됨. 최적의 부착물 배치·형태·접착 프로토콜에 대한 근거 기반 지침을 제공.

Effects of Composite Attachments on Orthodontic Clear Aligners Therapy: A Systematic Review
Nucera R, Dolci C, Bellocchio AM, Costa · 2022 sr
Systematic review (8 databases to Mar 2020, 5 clinical trials, medium risk of bias) on the effects of composite attachments on clear aligner treatment effectiveness — synthesizing evidence across six movement categories to identify where attachments help and where they do not.
체계적 문헌고찰 (8개 데이터베이스, 2020년 3월까지, 임상 5편, 중등도 비뚤림): 컴포지트 attachment가 투명교정 효과에 미치는 영향 — 6개 이동 카테고리에서 도움이 되는 곳과 안 되는 곳을 분리.

임플란트 표면처리 비교 — SLA·CA·UV 광기능화·골밀도화 매트릭스
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis matrix of 15 `implants/surface/` papers + 5 cross-cited across SLA/SA, hydrophilic CA/SLActive, UV photofunctionalization (UV-PF), and osseodensification (OD): SLA/SA remains the clinical standard (8y survival 94.8%, Kim 2020 retrospective n=96); hydrophilic CA/SLActive surfaces remove the D3/D4 stability dip without raising absolute ISQ (CA 5.2y 97.3% survival, MBL 0.074 mm, Kim 2022 n=258); UV-PF is first-line for atrophic/complex cases (ISQ +21.9 in complex sites, 7y 100% success, Hirota 2020 prospective).
임플란트 표면처리 15편 + 5편 횡단인용 종합 매트릭스: SLA/SA = 임상 표준(8년 생존 94.8%, Kim 2020 n=96); 친수성(CA/SLActive) = D3/D4 골에서 stability dip 제거, 절대 ISQ 상승은 아님(CA 5.2년 97.3%, MBL 0.074 mm, Kim 2022 n=258); UV 광기능화(UV-PF) = 위축골·복잡증례 1순위(ISQ +21.9, 7년 100% 성공, Hirota 2020 전향적).

First clinical SR+MA on UV photofunctionalization (7 studies, 5 meta-analyzed; 430 patients / 734 implants; Japan, Lithuania, Pakistan, Korea, India) isolating UV-PF from animal and plasma-based evidence.
UV 광기능화 (Photofunctionalization) 최초의 임상 SR+MA (7편, 5편 메타분석; 환자 430명·임플란트 734개; 일본·리투아니아·파키스탄·한국·인도) — 동물 및 플라즈마 기반 근거와 분리된 UV-PF 단독 분석.

A systematic review on the effect of inorganic surface coatings in large animal models and meta-analysis on tricalcium phosphate and hydroxyapatite on periimplant bone formation
Jeanne-Marie Damerau, Susanne Bierbaum, · 2021 sr+ma
Systematic review (40 large-animal studies, dog/goat/sheep/pig, 2003–2016) plus random-effects meta-analysis (15 studies) comparing tricalcium phosphate (TCP)- and hydroxyapatite (HA)-coated titanium implants against uncoated rough titanium reference surfaces on bone-to-implant contact (BIC) at 14 days, 21–28 days, and 42–84 days of healing.
대형동물모델 40편(개·염소·양·돼지, 2003–2016) 체계적 문헌고찰 + 15편 무작위효과 메타분석 — 삼인산칼슘 (Tricalcium Phosphate, TCP) 및 수산화인회석 (Hydroxyapatite, HA) 코팅 임플란트를 비코팅 거친 티타늄 대조군과 골-임플란트 접촉률 (Bone-to-Implant Contact, BIC)로 14일·21-28일·42-84일 시점 비교.

Implant Surface Characteristics and Peri-Implant Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Clinical and Microbiological Evidence
Gianna Dipalma, Grazia Marinelli, Paola · 2026 sr
Systematic review (PRISMA/PROSPERO #1301140, ROBINS-I) of 13 comparative human clinical studies (668 records screened → 13 included; 6 RCT, 3 prospective/controlled, 4 retrospective/pooled cohort; 18–600 patients, 35–630 implants) on implant surface characteristics and peri-implant clinical/radiographic/microbiological outcomes, PubMed/Scopus/Web of Science 2015–2025. Short/medium-term RCTs found minimal marginal bone loss (MBL) differences across surface types; long-term retrospective cohorts found rough surfaces associated with higher peri-implantitis odds (Ferrantino: OR 4.877, 95% CI 1.701–13.980; Raes: 12/42 TiUnite vs 3/41 turned at 5 years, p<0.01), but patient/site factors (smoking, periodontitis history, maintenance) outweighed surface effects; microbiological/biomolecular data were scarce. Clinical implication: surface modifications should be treated as adjunctive, not determinant, factors in peri-implant health — long-term risk assessment and supportive care matter more than surface choice.
PRISMA/PROSPERO(#1301140) 등록·ROBINS-I 평가 체계적 문헌고찰(668건 스크리닝 → 13편 포함; RCT 6·전향적/대조군 연구 3·후향적/통합코호트 4; 환자 18–600명, 임플란트 35–630개), PubMed/Scopus/Web of Science 2015–2025, 임플란트 표면 특성과 임플란트주위(Peri-Implant) 임상·방사선·미생물학적 결과의 관계를 종합. 단기·중기 RCT에서는 표면 유형 간 변연골소실(Marginal Bone Loss, MBL) 차이가 미미했으나, 장기 후향적 코호트에서는 거친 표면이 임플란트주위염(Peri-Implantitis) 오즈 증가와 연관(Ferrantino: OR 4.877, 95% CI 1.701–13.980; Raes: 5년 시점 TiUnite 12/42 vs turned 3/41, p<0.01)됐고, 환자·부위 위험요인(흡연·치주염력·유지관리)이 표면 효과보다 우세했다. 임상적으로 표면처리는 임플란트주위 건강의 결정 요인이 아니라 보조적(adjunctive) 요인으로 다뤄야 하며, 표면 선택보다 장기 위험평가와 유지관리 체계가 더 중요하다.

Evaluation of bone apposition on surface modified titanium implant in experimental animal model: A systematic review and meta-analysis
Priya Saini, Shaveta Sood, Gurparkash Si · 2024 sr+ma
SR+MA (PRISMA/PROSPERO CRD42020204907) of 37 preclinical animal studies (1891 implants, 513 animals — rabbits, dogs, pigs, sheep) comparing machined (turned) vs surface-modified titanium implants in healthy healed sites, 20 of which entered meta-analysis (BIC%, RTV, ISQ) for follow-up 1–12 weeks.
PRISMA/PROSPERO(CRD42020204907) 기반 SR+MA — 동물실험 37편(임플란트 1891개, 동물 513마리: 토끼·개·돼지·양), 이 중 20편이 메타분석(골-임플란트 접촉률(Bone-to-Implant Contact, BIC)%·제거토크값(Removal Torque Value, RTV)·임플란트 안정성 지수(Implant Stability Quotient, ISQ), 추적 1–12주)에 포함, 머신드(기계가공) 표면 vs 표면처리 티타늄 임플란트 비교.

Nanofeatured Titanium Surfaces for Dental Implants: A Systematic Evaluation of Osseointegration
Cristina Maria Șerbănescu, Viorel Ștefan · 2025 sr
Systematic review (PRISMA 2020, no meta-analysis; 25 studies: 4 human clinical [2 RCT, 2 non-randomized], 10 in vivo animal, 1 in vitro, 10 combined in vitro/in vivo) comparing nanocoated/nanostructured titanium implant surfaces (TiO2 nanotubes, HA/Ca-P, Ag, Sr, Zn/Mg, graphene/nanospikes) against conventional microrough (chiefly SLA/machined) titanium controls. 21/25 studies favored the nanosurface on ≥1 osseointegration metric (e.g., Ko et al. 2024 RCT: ISQ ~76.5 vs 71.3 at 2 months, ~79.1 vs 73.4 at 4 months, both p<0.01/p<0.0001; Li et al. 2023 dog model: BIC 76.6% vs 44.1% at 12 weeks for Sr-loaded vs plain TiO2-nanotube); gains are largest at 2–4 weeks and commonly converge with microrough controls by 8–12 weeks; GRADE certainty for patient-important clinical outcomes (MBL, survival) is low to very low. Nanofeatures accelerate early osseointegration and can add antibacterial activity without cytotoxicity, but no consistent long-term (≥12-month) survival/marginal-bone-loss advantage over contemporary microrough titanium is demonstrated — the authors call for adequately powered, preregistered ≥3–5-year head-to-head RCTs.
체계적 문헌고찰(PRISMA 2020, 메타분석 미시행; 연구 25편: 인체임상 4편[RCT 2, 비무작위 2], 동물생체내 10편, 시험관내 1편, 병합 10편) — 나노코팅/나노구조화 티타늄 표면(TiO2 나노튜브, HA/인산칼슘, 은(Ag), 스트론튬(Sr), 아연/마그네슘(Zn/Mg), 그래핀/나노스파이크)을 기존 마이크로거칠기(주로 SLA/기계가공) 티타늄 대조군과 비교. 25편 중 21편이 최소 1개 골유착 (Osseointegration) 지표에서 나노 표면 우위(예: Ko 등 2024 RCT — 임플란트 안정성 지수 (Implant Stability Quotient, ISQ) 2개월 ~76.5 vs 71.3, 4개월 ~79.1 vs 73.4, 모두 p<0.01/p<0.0001; Li 등 2023 개 모델 — 골-임플란트 접촉률 (Bone-to-Implant Contact, BIC) 12주 76.6% vs 44.1%[Sr첨가 vs 순수 TiO2나노튜브]); 격차는 2–4주에 최대, 8–12주면 대조군과 수렴하는 경우多; 환자-중요 임상결과(변연골소실, 생존율) 대상 GRADE 확신도는 낮음~매우낮음. 나노 표면은 초기 골유착을 가속하고 세포독성 없이 항균 효과를 더할 수 있으나, 현대 마이크로거칠기 티타늄 대비 장기(≥12개월) 생존율·변연골소실 우위는 입증되지 않음 — 저자들은 사전등록된 ≥3–5년 head-to-head RCT가 필요하다고 결론.

항균 가글 화학적 치면세균막 조절 종합 — 클로르헥시딘 vs 에센셜오일
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 11 papers (1 NMA of 53 RCTs, 1 Cochrane SR+MA of 51 RCTs, 1 post-surgical SR, 4 RCTs) on antiseptic mouthrinses: mouthrinses are adjuncts to mechanical hygiene and reduce plaque/gingivitis but never improve pocket depth or clinical attachment level.
항균 가글 11편 종합(네트워크 메타분석 1 + Cochrane 체계적 문헌고찰+메타분석 1 + 수술후 체계적 문헌고찰 1 + 무작위대조시험 4) — 가글은 기계적 위생의 보조이며 치은염·치태를 줄이지만 치주낭 깊이(Pocket Depth, PD)·부착수준(Clinical Attachment Level, CAL)은 개선하지 못한다.

Chlorhexidine mouthrinse as an adjunctive treatment for gingival health
James P, Worthington HV, Parnell C, Hard · 2017 sr+ma
Cochrane SR+MA (51 RCTs, n=5,345) evaluating CHX mouthrinse as an adjunct to mechanical oral hygiene in adults, assessing plaque, gingivitis, tooth staining, and adverse effects.
코크란 SR+MA (51 RCT, 5,345명) — 기계적 구강위생 보조제로서 CHX 가글의 치태·치은염·착색·부작용 평가.

Overview: Guided & Robotic Accuracy in Immediate Implant Placement (CAIS)
7-paper synthesis (2 IIP-specific NMAs + 5 robotic/navigation trials) on guided surgery accuracy in immediate implant placement: every guided protocol (partial-static, full-static, dynamic, robotic CAIS) significantly beats freehand on angular, platform, and apex deviation, with the advantage largest in IIP because the empty extraction socket deflects freehand drills toward the socket wall (palatal slope / facial).
즉시식립 전용 NMA 2편 + 로봇/내비 임상시험 5편 종합: IIP에서 모든 guided(partial/full-static, dynamic, robotic CAIS)가 freehand 대비 각도·플랫폼·첨부 편차를 유의하게 줄이며, 발치와 빈 공간이 freehand 드릴을 사면 방향으로 밀기 때문에 IIP에서 guided 이득이 가장 크다.

9개 RCT(12편, 참가자 395명, 임플란트 1,242개, 2024년 11월까지 검색)를 종합한 SR+MA로, 컴퓨터보조 임플란트수술(CAIS)과 자유수식립(FHIP)을 임상·방사선 결과(MBL, 생존율, PRO, 합병증)로 비교하고 Cochrane RoB·GRADE로 평가.

Invisalign + iTero: 디지털 워크플로우와 이동 정확도 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Invisalign and iTero form a vertically integrated digital orthodontic ecosystem: iTero is the predominant intraoral scanner (IOS) among orthodontic digital users (86%), and its acquisition is associated with a significant increase in Invisalign treatment starts (+20.71%, ITS; Mackay 2017 — manufacturer data, association only); digitally, iTero 3D models superimposed via palatal-rugae registration are the de-facto measurement standard for ClinCheck accuracy research, and ClinCheck arch-width table values have been independently metrologically validated (de-la-Rosa-Gay 2026).
인비절라인(Invisalign)과 아이테로(iTero)는 수직통합 디지털 교정 생태계를 구성: 교정과 디지털 사용자의 86%가 iTero를 선택하고, 도입 시 Invisalign 시작 건수가 유의하게 증가하지만(+20.71%, ITS, 제조사 데이터 — 연관성 수준; Mackay 2017), 디지털 측면에서 iTero 3D 모델의 구개주름 중첩(palatal rugae registration)이 ClinCheck 정확도 연구의 사실상 표준이며, ClinCheck 아치폭 표 수치의 독립적 계측 타당성도 검증됨(de-la-Rosa-Gay 2026).
VS
Intraoral Scanners in Orthodontics: A Critical Review
Isidora Christopoulou, Eleftherios G. Ka · 2022 narrative-review
Critical/narrative review (7 databases searched inception–October 2020 plus hand-searched gray literature; no PRISMA/PROSPERO, no risk-of-bias assessment) synthesizing orthodontic clinical trials on intraoral scanner (IOS) accuracy, reproducibility, duration, patient comfort/preference, and operator experience versus conventional (alginate/PVS) impressions.
서술적 critical review(7개 DB, inception–2020.10 전수검색 + 회색문헌 손검색; PRISMA·PROSPERO 없음, 비뚤림위험 평가 없음): 교정과(orthodontics) 임상시험을 대상으로 구강스캐너(Intraoral Scanner, IOS)의 정확도·재현성·소요시간·환자 편의/선호·술자 경험을 재래식(알지네이트/PVS) 인상과 비교 종합.

Implant Abutment & Restoration Interface — Material (Zirconia vs Titanium) · Morphology/Emergence · Fit · Field Trends
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Hub over 6 papers on the implant abutment/restoration interface across 4 axes: on **material**, zirconia and titanium abutments are clinically equivalent (Davoudi 2025 umbrella, 14 SRs / 10,063 implants: survival Zr 98.6–98.8% vs Ti 98.62–99.4%, MBL/mechanical complications mostly NS) despite titanium's bench superiority (fracture resistance 1454 N vs 443.6 N), so material choice is esthetics/phenotype-driven (IAO consensus agrees) — but a critical caveat: this parity is about *abutments*, and two-piece zirconia *implant bodies* underperformed in Sterzenbach 2025's RCT (survival 89.3% vs 100% titanium, non-inferiority not confirmed, osseointegration failures), a gap the non-significant p=0.068 obscures.
임플란트 지대주·보철 계면 4축(재료·형태/emergence·적합도·동향)을 6편으로 종합: 지대주 재료는 지르코니아 ≈ 티타늄(Davoudi umbrella 생존 Zr 98.6–98.8% vs Ti 98.62–99.4%, 대부분 무차이)이나 벤치 강도는 Ti 압도(1454 vs 443.6N), 선택은 심미 주도 — 단 이 동등성은 지대주 한정이고 2편 지르코니아 임플란트체는 열등(Sterzenbach RCT 89.3% vs 100%, p=0.068이 격차 가림).

Consensus Report by the Italian Academy of Osseointegration on the Importance of Peri-Implant Soft Tissues
Bressan E, Zucchelli G, Tommasato G, Pes · 2024 consensus
This is a 2024 IAO (Italian Academy of Osseointegration) consensus conference synthesizing 4 pre-registered PRISMA/PROSPERO systematic reviews on peri-implant soft tissue: keratinized mucosa (KM), collagen matrix vs. autogenous graft, abutment material, and soft-tissue thickness vs. marginal bone loss (MBL).
2024년 IAO(Italian Academy of Osseointegration) 컨센서스 컨퍼런스로, 사전등록(PROSPERO/PRISMA) 4편의 체계적 문헌고찰을 근거로 각성점막폭(Keratinized Mucosa width, KMW)·콜라겐 매트릭스 vs 자가이식·지대주 재료·연조직 두께 대 변연골소실(Marginal Bone Loss, MBL) 4개 주제에 투표 방식 합의문을 도출했다.

디지털 총의치 비용·워크플로우 합의 — 디지털 vs 전통 비용 동등성, 전문가 합의 프로토콜
Synthesis · 2026 synthesis
Two 2025 publications — a 27-author expert consensus (Feng) and an SR+MA of 5 cost studies (n=184, Muehlemann) — converge on the same answer: digital complete dentures are equivalent to conventional in outcomes that matter (cost, satisfaction, OHRQoL, session count), while saving 58–233 minutes of clinical chair time.
2025년 두 편의 연구(27인 합의문 Feng + SR+MA 5편 Muehlemann, n=184)가 동일한 결론으로 수렴: 디지털 총의치는 임상적으로 중요한 결과(비용·만족도·OHRQoL·내원횟수)에서 전통 의치와 동등하되, 임상시간은 58–233분 절감된다.

27인 중국 다기관 보철과 전문가 합의문으로, 디지털 총의치의 적응증부터 구강 내/안모 스캔, 커스텀 트레이·악간관계 디지털 디자인, 인공치 배열, 적층(SLA/DLP)/절삭(CNC 밀링) 제작, 평가지표까지 표준화된 워크플로우를 제시하였다.

Overview: Severe Jaw Atrophy — the Graftless Rehabilitation Ladder (숏·경사·관골·골막하 임플란트)
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 8 papers spanning the four graftless options for severe jaw atrophy — 4-mm short implants (Barausse 2024, 212 patients/496 implants, mean 8.02 y), short-vs-sinus-graft head-to-head (Chaware 2021, 22 RCTs/1,595 implants), tilted full-arch implants (Del Fabbro 2022, 24 studies/2,637 patients), zygomatic implants (Scocca 2026, 17 studies/679 ZIs), and customized 3D-printed subperiosteal implants (Cosola 2026, 11 studies/369 implants) — plus the sinusitis (Rocha 2023) and prosthetic-maintenance (Ng 2026) cost layers.

Four-mm-short implants in the rehabilitation of posterior atrophic jaws: A retrospective study on 212 patients with a mean follow-up of 8.02 years
Carlo Barausse, Roberto Pistilli, Lorenz · 2024 retrospective
Retrospective study of 4-mm short implants in 212 patients (496 implants, mean 8.02-year follow-up) placed in posterior severely atrophic jaws (mandibular or maxillary) by a single surgical team, with minimum 3-year post-loading follow-up.
4 mm 초단 임플란트 후향 코호트: 212명·496 임플란트, 평균 추적 8.02년, 단일 수술팀, 상·하악 후방 중증 위축악, 최소 하중 후 3년 이상 추적.

Overview: Severe Jaw Atrophy — the Graftless Rehabilitation Ladder (숏·경사·관골·골막하 임플란트)
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 8 papers spanning the four graftless options for severe jaw atrophy — 4-mm short implants (Barausse 2024, 212 patients/496 implants, mean 8.02 y), short-vs-sinus-graft head-to-head (Chaware 2021, 22 RCTs/1,595 implants), tilted full-arch implants (Del Fabbro 2022, 24 studies/2,637 patients), zygomatic implants (Scocca 2026, 17 studies/679 ZIs), and customized 3D-printed subperiosteal implants (Cosola 2026, 11 studies/369 implants) — plus the sinusitis (Rocha 2023) and prosthetic-maintenance (Ng 2026) cost layers.
심한 악골 위축의 무이식 선택지 4가지를 8편으로 종합 — 4 mm 숏 임플란트(Barausse 2024, 212명/496개, 평균 8.02년), 숏 vs 상악동거상 직접비교(Chaware 2021, RCT 22편/1,595개), 경사 임플란트 전악(Del Fabbro 2022, 24편/2,637명), 관골 임플란트(Scocca 2026, 17편/679개), 맞춤형 3D프린팅 골막하 임플란트(Cosola 2026, 11편/369개) + 부비동염(Rocha 2023)·보철 유지부담(Ng 2026) 비용층.
