Immediate Implant Placement — Evidence Hub: Survival · Timing · Infected Sockets · Loading & Restoration
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Evidence hub over 27 papers spanning immediate (Type 1) placement's five decision axes — survival, placement/loading timing, infected sockets, loading/restoration, and patient-reported experience: the current reference for the survival question is Gallucci 2026 (PROSPERO-updated SR, 140 studies, 10,456 implants), whose 9-combination weighted-survival/validation-tier table shows Type 1A (immediate placement + immediate loading) at a validated 98.0% but **Type 1B (immediate placement + early loading) at only 91.6%, still under-validated** — roughly a 4-fold difference in implant loss hiding inside "immediate placement" depending on loading timing alone.
즉시식립(Type 1)의 5개 결정축(생존·타이밍·감염소켓·부하/보철·환자체감)을 27편으로 종합한 허브: 생존율의 새 기준은 Gallucci 2026(PROSPERO 갱신 SR, 140편·10,456임플란트) — 9조합 가중생존율에서 Type 1A(즉시+즉시부하) 98.0%(검증됨) 대비 **Type 1B(즉시+조기부하) 91.6%(미검증)**로 손실률 약 4배 차이.
VS
Immediate implant placement into fresh extraction sockets versus delayed implants into healed sockets: A systematic review and meta-analysis
Mello CC, Lemos CAA, Verri FR, Dos Santo · 2017 sr+ma
Systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42016043309; 30 eligible studies, search through November 2016) of 3,049 implants in 1,435 patients (mean age 46.68 years, minimum 6-month follow-up), comparing immediate implant placement in fresh extraction sockets versus delayed implant placement in healed sockets.
체계적 문헌고찰+메타분석 (PROSPERO CRD42016043309; 적격 연구 30편, 2016년 11월까지 검색): 발치와 신선 소켓 3,049개 임플란트(환자 1,435명, 평균 46.68세, 최소 6개월 추적) — 즉시식립 (Immediate Implant Placement, IIP) vs 치유된 소켓 지연식립 비교.

Garcia-Sanchez R, Dopico J, Kalemaj Z, B · 2022 sr+ma
Systematic review and meta-analysis addressing two focused questions on immediate versus delayed dental implant placement (search through November 2019; MEDLINE, EMBASE, CENTRAL, OpenGray + hand search, 6457 records → 138 full-text): Q1 pooled 6 head-to-head RCTs comparing immediate vs delayed placement (495 patients, 480 implants); Q2 pooled 53 studies (22 RCTs, 11 CCTs, 20 case series) of immediate placement alone.

synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 26 papers (11 RCTs, 1 SR, **1 SR+MA**, 2 prospective, 3 case-report, 5 in-vitro, 1 retrospective, 1 animal, 1 narrative-review) on suture and wound-closure decisions stratified by a single upstream variable — wound tension — which bifurcates into two clinical contexts with opposite optimization goals.
26편 종합(RCT 11, SR 1, **SR+MA 1**, 전향적 2, case-report 3, in-vitro 5, 후향적 1, animal 1, narrative-review 1) — 봉합·창상폐쇄 결정은 단일 상류 변수인 창상 장력(wound tension)에 의해 정반대 최적화 목표를 가진 두 맥락으로 분기한다.

Overview: Narrow-Diameter Implants — Clinical Outcomes Across Indications
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026
Synthesis of 4 SR/MAs spanning four clinical indications — esthetic anterior maxilla (Zhang 2024, 5 studies/282 NDI vs RDI+augmentation), load-bearing posterior fixed prostheses (Pachiou 2025, 36 trials/2741 NDI), mandibular overdentures (Park 2023, 8 studies), and titanium-zirconium single crowns (Cao 2023, 7 studies/256 Ti-Zr NDI): narrow-diameter implants (<3.75 mm) match regular-diameter implants on survival (RR 0.989, p=0.896 anterior; pooled 97.0% maxillary/96.5% mandibular posterior) and marginal bone loss across all four indications.
좁은 직경 임플란트(Narrow-Diameter Implant, NDI, <3.75 mm)의 임상 결과를 4개 적응증 SR/MA 4편으로 종합: 전치부 상악(Zhang 2024)·구치부 고정성 보철(Pachiou 2025, n=2741)·하악 피개의치(Park 2023)·TiZr 단일크라운(Cao 2023) 모두에서 NDI는 정규직경(RDI)과 생존율·변연골소실(MBL)이 통계적으로 동등하고, 심미 합병증과 환자보고결과(PROM)에서는 오히려 우위다.

임플란트 교합 — 교합양식·접촉변화·과부하 생역학 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of the implant occlusion cluster (~20 papers across clinical, FEA, and animal studies): the absence of a periodontal ligament means occlusal force on osseointegrated implants is neither cushioned nor sensed, so the design goal is to minimize and distribute load — active tactile thresholds of implants (10–100 µm) are consistently higher than natural teeth (<10–50 µm, Singh 2026 SR), and "light occlusion" reduces immediate force but is unstable over time as contacts drift and force increases (Zhang 2022 prospective, n=50, T-Scan III).
임플란트 교합 클러스터 ~20편 종합(임상·FEA·동물): 치주인대(PDL) 부재로 교합력이 완충·감지되지 않아 임플란트의 능동 촉각 역치(10–100 µm)가 자연치(<10–50 µm)보다 둔하고(Singh 2026 SR), "약교합"은 즉시 힘을 낮추나 시간이 지나며 교합력이 증가해 유지 안 됨(Zhang 2022 전향, n=50).

Charlotte Stilwell · 2024 narrative-review
British Dental Journal narrative review (2024) on occlusal considerations during implant maintenance; expert opinion synthesizing the hardware and biological risks arising from occlusal overload in implant-supported restorations.

Diabetic Patient + Immediate Implant: An HbA1c- and Site-Gated Decision Synthesis
synthesis
Cross-paper synthesis (4 contributing papers: Wagner 2022 SR, Al-Ansari 2022 SR+MA 89 studies, Andrade 2021 SR+MA, Ragucci 2020 SR+MA) on when a diabetic patient can receive an immediate implant: DM is not an absolute contraindication, but the decision is gated by HbA1c band (<8% proceed / 8–9% enhanced precautions / ≥9% defer) and site (maxilla carries the significant DM failure signal OR 1.777, p<0.001; mandible does not).
당뇨 환자 즉시식립 가부를 여러 논문으로 종합한 페이지: DM은 절대 금기가 아니며, 결정은 **HbA1c 밴드(<8%/8–9%/≥9%)** 와 **부위(상악은 당뇨 실패 유의, 하악은 비유의)** 로 갈린다 — 두 SR+MA는 단기·하악 생존에선 일치하나 상악·장기 위험에선 충돌한다.

구강 미생물군·바이오필름 매트릭스·dysbiosis 종합 (Oral Microbiome / Biofilm Matrix / PSD)
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 24 oral-microbiology review papers (anchored on Socransky 1998 community-complex and Costerton 1999 biofilm paradigms) framing caries and periodontitis as community dysbiosis across three axes: EPS/matrixome matrix (glucan-driven acidic microenvironment, pH 4.5–5.5, with >2 h buffering resistance); microbial ecology (~1,000 oral species, ~50 per site, health=generalist → disease=specialist, refined by Baker 2024's species-level biogeography); and pathogenesis (periodontitis = P. gingivalis keystone-driven Polymicrobial Synergy & Dysbiosis [PSD] despite <0.01% abundance, strain-specific per Murugaiyan 2024, though Scannapieco 2021 counters that common periodontitis is better described as increased-diversity "personalized pathology" than true dysbiosis; caries = sucrose-EPS feedforward loop amplified by intraspecies S. mutans diversity and Candida interactions); Kozak 2023 extends the oral-systemic link list to COPD, COVID-19 severity, Alzheimer's disease, diabetes, and pancreatic/colorectal cancer.
구강 미생물·바이오필름 review 24편 통합(Socransky 1998 complex paradigm + Costerton 1999 biofilm paradigm 2개 historical foundation 포함): 3축 — ①매트릭스(EPS/matrixome): glucan이 caries 바이오필름 핵심 virulence, 국소 산성 미세환경(pH 4.5–5.5) 2시간 이상 지속; ②생태(microbiome): ~1,000종·부위당 ~50종, 건강=generalist·질환=specialist(Baker 2024가 종수준 biogeography로 정밀화); ③병인(dysbiosis): 치주염은 keystone pathogen P. gingivalis(<0.01%)가 주도하는 PSD 모델·균주특이적(Murugaiyan 2024)이나, Scannapieco 2021은 흔한 치주염이 진짜 dysbiosis(다양성 감소)가 아닌 다양성 *증가*형 personalized pathology에 가깝다고 반박; caries는 sucrose-EPS feedforward loop — 둘 다 군집 수준 현상. Kozak 2023은 구강-전신 연관을 COPD·COVID-19·알츠하이머·당뇨·췌장/대장암까지 확장.

조직수준 vs 골수준 임플란트 — 변연골·주위염·연조직·생존 결과 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 10 papers (2 SR, 1 SR+MA, 2 prospective/case-control, 2 retrospective, 2 animal + 1 long-term RCT) comparing tissue-level (TL) vs bone-level (BL) implants: survival is equivalent (>90–100%) across all evidence levels, and SR/SR+MA analyses find no statistically significant MBL difference, but controlled head-to-head clinical studies consistently show TL loses 0.25–0.66 mm less marginal bone (TL 0.31 vs BL 0.97 mm at 2 years, p<0.001; Agustín-Panadero 2021; TL 0.30 vs BL 0.55 mm at 1 year, p=0.003; Lombardi 2025).
10편 종합(2 SR, 1 SR+MA, 2 전향/케이스-대조, 2 후향, 2 동물 + 장기 RCT 1): 생존율은 TL·BL 모두 동등(>90–100%)하고 SR/SR+MA 수준에서는 MBL 유의차 없으나, 동질 head-to-head 임상연구들은 TL이 0.25–0.66 mm 적은 변연골 소실을 일관되게 보임(TL 0.31 vs BL 0.97 mm, p<0.001; Agustín-Panadero 2021; 15–17년 RCT에서 1-piece MBL 0.08 vs 2-piece 1.53 mm, p<0.001, 단 기술 합병증 6배↑; Pirc 2026).

synthesis · 2026 synthesis

9편 종합(CCLAD·The Wand·STA·바늘없는 주사기): 가장 엄격한 5군 RCT(Küçükkurt 2026, n=200)는 5개 전달시스템 간 주사통증 유의차 없음(p=0.380, 모든 g<0.20); 장비 작동원리 사전 설명도 불안·통증 감소 못 함(Rizzo-Lorenzo 2020 RCT).

투명교정 부작용 종합 — 자주 보고되는 부작용(AE)과 치근흡수·통증의 정량화
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
This synthesis aggregates the held evidence on adverse effects of removable clear-aligner therapy. Pain follows a predictable 24h-peak → day-3-decline → 1-week-minimum curve. External apical root resorption (EARR) is consistently small across three complementary measurement approaches (CBCT SR-MA −0.56 mm absolute; RCT AI-3D median −0.72 mm, no CA-vs-fixed difference; SR-MA −0.33 mm linear), with severe resorption (>20% root loss) in only ~3.7–6.3% of teeth. Aligners appear more favorable than fixed appliances for plaque and white-spot lesions, while plaque removal is governed more by surface accessibility than toothbrush type. The synthesis closes with an informed-consent checklist and a note on how differing measurement lenses reconcile the disparate root-resorption numbers.
투명교정(가역적 장치) 부작용에 대해 보유한 근거를 종합. 통증은 "24시간 내 정점 → 3일째 감소 → 1주째 최소화"의 예측 가능한 곡선. 외부 유치단 흡수(EARR)는 세 가지 보완적 측정 접근에서 모두 미미 — CBCT SR-MA −0.56mm(절대), RCT AI-3D 중앙값 −0.72mm(CA vs 고정교정 무차이), SR-MA −0.33mm(선형); 심각 흡수(>20% 치근 손실)는 치아의 약 3.7–6.3%만. 플라크·백색병소는 고정교정보다 유리, 플라크 제거는 칫솔 종류보다 표면 접근성이 좌우. 치근흡수 "수치" 인용 시 측정 렌즈(절대/비교, 3D/2D)를 반드시 함께 명시. 동의서 항목과 임상 체크리스트로 마무리.
VS
Quantifying Root Resorption on the Incisors After Clear Aligner and Fixed Appliance Therapy Using Artificial Intelligence Tool Based CBCT Surface Models: Randomized Clinical Trial
Roberto Bespalez-Neto, Claudia Trindade · 2026 rct
This RCT compared external apical root resorption (EARR) on incisors after non-extraction Class I malocclusion treatment using clear aligners (n=15) vs fixed appliances (n=17) with novel 3D AI-based CBCT surface analysis. Overall median EARR was −0.72 mm with no significant difference between groups; upper lateral incisors showed significantly greater EARR than lower incisors (p=0.002) and upper central incisors (p<0.001). No significant predictor was found for age, sex, crowding severity, or treatment duration.
비발치 Class I 부정교합 환자에서 투명교정(n=15) 대 고정교정(n=17) 후 전치의 외부 유치단 흡수(EARR)를 AI 기반 CBCT 3D 표면 분석으로 비교한 RCT. 전체 중앙값 EARR는 −0.72mm로 두 그룹 간 유의한 차이 없었으며, 상악 측절치가 하악 전치(p=0.002) 및 상악 중절치(p<0.001)보다 유의하게 더 큰 EARR를 보임. 나이·성별·혼잡도·치료 기간은 EARR의 유의한 예측인이 아니었음.

5편(건강인 약력학 RCT 1편, OA+IHD 환자 RCT 1편, 9종 NSAID 인비트로 스크린 1편, 피라졸리논 인비트로 1편, 아스피린 State-of-the-Art 종설 1편) 종합: 특정 NSAID는 혈소판 COX-1 소수성 통로를 경쟁적으로 점유해 아스피린의 비가역적 Ser-529/530 아세틸화를 차단함으로써 항혈소판 효과를 소실시킨다.

Postoperative Analgesics·Pain Management Overview
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 55 papers (24 SR+MA/network MA, 3 SR, 10 RCTs, 2 retrospective cohorts, 10 narrative reviews, 6 guideline/consensus documents) on acute dental pain management, anchored by the 2024 ADA clinical practice guideline (Carrasco-Labra 2024, JADA 155:102-117) — the first systematically developed ADA guideline: nonopioid first-line (NSAID alone or + acetaminophen 500 mg) for all scenarios; opioids recommended AGAINST after simple extraction; optional opioid-combination second line reserved for rare inadequate control after surgical extraction (lowest dose, fewest tablets, rarely >3 days); corticosteroids recommended AGAINST as analgesic adjuncts (Conditional, Very Low) because their pooled pain reduction falls below a 10-point triviality threshold (Miroshnychenko 2023 SR, 40 RCTs) — anti-edema and anti-trismus use is out of scope.
치과 급성 통증 55편(SR+MA·Network MA 24·SR 3·RCT 10·후향 2·narrative 10·지침·합의 6) 통합: **2024 ADA 공식 CPG**(Carrasco-Labra 2024)가 최초 체계적 지침 — 전 시나리오 비오피오이드 1선(NSAID 단독 또는 + APAP 500mg); 단순 발치는 오피오이드 반대 권고, 외과 발치는 불충분 시에만 오피오이드 2선; 코르티코스테로이드 진통 보조는 반대 권고(통증 감소가 무의미 임계치 미만, Miroshnychenko 2023 SR; 부종·개구제한 목적은 범위 밖); ibuprofen 400mg + APAP 병용이 NNT ≈1.5 최강(Miroshnychenko 2023 NMA 82 RCT n=9,095).
🟡 조건부 반박overviews
보존적 접근와동의 생역학 — 이득은 조건부, 대가는 무조건부 (Conservative Access Cavity Biomechanics)
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 12 papers resolving an apparent contradiction in conservative access cavity (CEC) biomechanics: pooled analyses report a significant fracture-resistance advantage for CEC over traditional endodontic cavities (TEC) — SUCRA 51.4% vs 15.3%, ~562 N difference (Motiwala 2022, 10 molar studies, n=456); SMD 2.61, 95% CI 1.47–3.74, p<0.001 (Mrinalini 2024, 14 studies) — while the three best-controlled individual in vitro studies find no fracture-resistance difference whatsoever (Barbosa 2020, Lima 2021, Rover 2020, all P>0.05).
논문 12편(네트워크 메타분석 1·쌍대 메타분석 2·체계적 고찰 3·통제 체외연구 3) 종합 — 보존적 접근와동 (Conservative Endodontic Cavity, CEC) 생역학의 겉보기 모순을 해소: 풀링 분석은 CEC가 전통 접근와동 (Traditional Endodontic Cavity, TEC)보다 파절저항이 유의하게 높다고 보고하는 반면(Motiwala 2022 — 누적순위곡선하면적 (Surface Under the Cumulative Ranking, SUCRA) 51.4% vs 15.3%, 약 562 N 차이, 대구치 10편 n=456; Mrinalini 2024 — 표준화평균차 (Standardized Mean Difference, SMD) 2.61, 95% CI 1.47–3.74, p<0.001, 14편), 가장 잘 통제된 개별 체외연구 3편은 파절저항 차이를 전혀 찾지 못했다(Barbosa 2020·Lima 2021·Rover 2020, 모두 P>0.05).

Traditional and minimally invasive access cavities in endodontics: a literature review
Ioanna Kapetanaki, Fotis Dimopoulos, Chr · 2021 narrative-review
Literature review (PubMed/Scopus/Web of Science) comparing traditional endodontic cavity (TEC) and minimally invasive access (MIA) designs on canal location, instrument operation, fracture resistance, and iatrogenic risk.
문헌고찰(PubMed/Scopus/WoS): 전통 접근와동(TEC)과 최소침습 접근와동(MIA)을 근관구 위치·기구 조작·파절 저항·의원성 위험 측면에서 비교.
🟡 조건부 반박overviews
NSAID·아스피린 알러지 환자의 치과 진통제 선택 — 표현형이 결정한다 (교차반응형 vs 약물특이형)
Synthesis · 2026 synthesis
A reported "NSAID allergy" or "aspirin allergy" is not one diagnosis — it is a phenotype question, and the phenotype (established from three history questions and, when unclear, an oral aspirin challenge) decides whether another NSAID, a selective COX-2 inhibitor, or only acetaminophen is safe for dental analgesia.
보고된 "NSAID 알러지"·"아스피린 알러지"는 하나의 진단이 아니라 표현형(phenotype) 질문이다 — 병력 3문항과, 애매하면 경구 아스피린 유발검사로 표현형을 정하고, 그 표현형이 다른 NSAID·선택적 COX-2 억제제·아세트아미노펜 중 무엇이 치과 진통에 안전한지를 결정한다.

임플란트 표면 분자 기전 기초 — Sa 최적 범위의 생물학적 근거 및 표면처리 분류
Synthesis · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of two foundational narrative reviews (Koshy 2015; Ballo 2011) providing the mechanistic basis for the Sa 1–2 µm clinical optimum: surface modification taxonomy (additive / subtractive / material-modification) and the four-grade roughness continuum (smooth < 0.5 µm → moderately rough 1.0–2.0 µm optimal → rough > 2.0 µm) explain why SLA at Sa ~1.5–2 µm is the gold standard.
두 기초 서술 고찰(Koshy 2015; Ballo 2011) 종합 — Sa 1–2 µm 임상 최적범위의 분자적 근거: 표면처리 3분류(첨가형·삭감형·재질변형)와 거칠기 4등급(smooth < 0.5 µm → 중간 거칠기 1.0–2.0 µm 최적 → rough > 2.0 µm) 프레임이 SLA(Sa ~1.5–2 µm)가 표준인 이유를 구조화.

Three oral surgery complication domains synthesized — alveolar osteitis prevention after extraction (CHX SR+MA, 23 RCTs, n=2,824; intrasocket-intervention NMA, 37 RCTs; plus risk-factor and incidence cohorts), saline irrigation during oral cancer surgery (prospective cohort, n=104), and orthognathic surgery nerve injury treatment (retrospective cohort, n=287, benchmarked against a third-molar surgery cohort).

투명교정(Clear Aligner) 적응증·한계 종합

Bone Quality → Implant Risk & Modification Overview (골질·골밀도별 임플란트 위험·수정전략)
synthesis (llm-wiki) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 23 papers organizing bone quality as the risk axis: local density (Lekholm-Zarb I–IV / Misch D1–D4) sets primary stability and failure risk — type IV bone fails ~1.5–1.9× more (Rosa 2024 SR+MA, 49 studies, 29,905 implants) with ISQ 58–65 vs 72–80 for type I — and crestal cortical thickness, not cancellous volume depth, is the dominant stability driver (Chatvaratthana 2017, Di Stefano 2021).
골질(Bone Quality)을 "위험 축"으로 묶은 23편 종합: 국소 골밀도(Lekholm-Zarb I–IV / Misch D1–D4)가 초기 안정성·실패 위험을 결정하고(type IV는 ~1.5–1.9배 실패, ISQ 58–65 vs type I 72–80; Rosa 2024 SR+MA, 55편·29,905개), 해면골 양이 아닌 **치조정 피질골 두께(Crestal Cortical Thickness)**가 안정성의 핵심이다.

서술적 고찰(Narrative Review) — 골밀도(Bone Density) 분류 체계(Misch D1–D4, Lekholm-Zarb I–IV), CBCT 하운스필드 단위(Hounsfield Unit, HU) 기준값, 골질이 골유착(Osseointegration) 및 1차 안정성(Primary Stability)에 미치는 생역학적 기전 종합.

세라믹 접착 — HF 처리·실란 선택·오염 제거·대안 시멘트 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Nine in vitro studies establish that successful silica-based ceramic bonding depends on a chain of four decisions: HF concentration (feldspathic ceramic requires ≥3%, with 10% optimal for durability after aging; Venturini 2015, Moura 2020); dedicated prehydrolyzed silane primer (most universal adhesives contain inactive siloxane forms — only Calibra Silane contained active silanol monomers by NMR; Dimitriadi 2019) followed by a separate adhesive layer (silane alone without adhesive equals untreated control; Simasetha 2021).
9편 인 비트로(in vitro) 연구 종합: 실리카 기반 세라믹 접착 성공은 4가지 결정의 연쇄 — ①불산(HF) 농도 ≥3%(장석계는 10% 최적, 노화 내구성 근거; Moura 2020), ②별도 사전가수분해 실란 프라이머(대부분 유니버설 접착제는 비활성 실록산 함유, Calibra Silane만 활성 실라놀; Dimitriadi 2019 NMR), ③실란 후 접착제 레이어(실란 단독은 무처리 대조군과 차이 없음; Simasetha 2021).
VS
Bonding Durability Between Zirconia and Different Types of Tooth or Implant Abutments—A Systematic Review. Part II: Outcomes of Clinical Studies

PRISMA 기반 체계적 문헌고찰(2,856편 → 24편 임상연구 포함; 2020년 9월까지; 정성 합성, 이질성으로 메타분석 불가): 치아·임플란트 지대치에 대한 지르코니아 수복물의 임상 접착 내구성을 표면처리·프라이머·레진 시멘트 유형별로 검토.

Watanabe Toothpick Method (이쑤시개법) of Toothbrushing — Evidence Synthesis
synthesis page (compiled by Claude from · 2026 synthesis
7-paper synthesis (1995–2026) on the Watanabe toothpick method (TPM): a double-row brush technique with a dual mechanism — superior proximal plaque removal and gingival wound-healing stimulation (~2.5× basement-cell proliferation vs scaler); the origin RCT confirms TPM > Bass on proximal plaque (Morita 1998), and benefits extend to diabetic periodontitis (BOP −16.5% vs SRP alone −7.3%, serum endotoxin decreased; Lee 2020 RCT) and peri-implant mucositis as an agent-delivery vehicle (Kim 2025 RCT).
Watanabe 이쑤시개법(TPM, 칫솔질) 7편(1995–2026) 종합: 2열모 칫솔 치간 삽입 기법으로 인접면 플라그 제거 + 치은 치유 자극(기저세포 증식 ~2.5배)의 이중 기전; 원전 RCT(Morita 1998)는 TPM > Bass on proximal plaque; 당뇨 치주염서 SRP+TPM이 BOP −16.5% vs SRP 단독 −7.3%·혈청 내독소 유일 감소(Lee 2020 RCT); 임플란트 주위 점막염에서 약제 전달 도구로 유효하나 기계적 단독(식염수-TPM)은 12균종 중 5종 오히려 증가 → 항균제 병용 필수(Kim 2025 RCT).

Evaluating the hidden impact of interdental cleaning habits on maxillary anterior papilla integrity: a cross-sectional study
El Haddad S, Bukhary F, Alkhaldi A, Alot · 2026 cross-sectional
Cross-sectional study (n=69, ages 20–29, 87% toothpick users exclusively; no floss or interdental brush users) quantifying the effect of habitual wooden-toothpick use on maxillary anterior interdental papilla via the Papilla Presence Index (PPI).
단면연구(n=69, 20–29세, 87%가 나무 이쑤시개만 사용, 치실·치간칫솔 사용자 제외): 치간 세균막 제거 도구로 나무 이쑤시개만 쓰는 사람들의 상악 전치부 치간유두 손상을 치간유두 존재지수(Papilla Presence Index, PPI)로 평가.

대합치 없는 치아의 정출(과맹출) — 역학·기전·임상결정 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 17 papers: unopposed posterior teeth over-erupt in ~83% of cases (mean 0.43 mm / max 0.75 mm over ~9 months short-term; mesial cusp 1.37 mm at ~5 years by CBCT [Hong 2023]; ~72% < 1 mm short-term; fastest early; 3D vertical + buccal-tipping + rotation; ~18% never move); the process is PDL/alveolar-bone–driven and independent of pulp vitality.
17편 종합: 대합치 없는 후방 치아의 ~83%가 정출(단기 ~9개월 평균 0.43 mm / 최대 0.75 mm; CBCT 5년 기준 근심교두 1.37 mm [Hong 2023]; ~72%는 1 mm 미만; 초기 최대 속도; 수직+협측경사+회전 3D); ~18%는 전혀 안 움직임; 정출은 PDL·치조골 매개라 치수 생활력 무관.

An investigation of overeruption of posterior teeth with partial occlusal contact
H. L. Craddock, C. C. Youngson, M. Manog · 2007 retrospective
Retrospective clinical observational study (n=91 adults) comparing vertical overeruption and tipping in posterior teeth that had either complete antagonist loss or only partial occlusal contact remaining.
완전 무대합 또는 부분 교합접촉(Partial Occlusal Contact)만 남은 구치를 가진 성인 91명의 수직 과맹출(Overeruption)과 경사(Tipping)를 비교한 후향적 임상 관찰 연구.
🟡 조건부 반박overviews
Implant Spacing & Proximity → Interproximal Crestal Bone (임플란트 간격·근접 → 치간 치조정골 종합)
Synthesis · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 4 papers: interproximal crestal bone loss is dominated by horizontal spacing, not vertical implant depth — each fixture creates ~1.4 mm of lateral bone loss, so inter-implant distance (IID) <3 mm causes 2.3× more crestal bone loss than IID >3 mm (Tarnow 2000); modern internal-conical platform-switched designs may defend gaps down to 1–2 mm (Morales Schwarz 2025, n=1 + 2 animal studies), but the evidence weight still favors ≥3 mm.
4편 종합: 치간 치조정골소실은 수직 깊이가 아닌 수평 간격이 지배 — 각 임플란트에서 측방 골소실 ~1.4 mm 발생, 임플란트간 거리(IID) <3 mm 시 >3 mm 대비 2.3배 치조정 골소실(Tarnow 2000); 현대 내부 원추형+플랫폼 스위칭 디자인은 1–2 mm 간격 방어 가능(Morales Schwarz 2025, n=1+동물 2편)이나 근거 무게는 여전히 ≥3 mm 권장 지지.
VS
The impact of a 1 mm interimplant distance on the interproximal crestal bone height: a case report with a 10-year follow-up and literature review
Morales Schwarz D, Szmukler-Moncler S, M · 2025 case-report
Case report + literature review (1 mm inter-implant distance, modern platform-switching bone-level implants with internal conical connection, subcrestal placement, 10-year follow-up): first clinical case of 1 mm IID to 10 years with quantified bone outcomes.
케이스보고 + 문헌고찰 (임플란트 간 거리(IID) 1 mm, 내부 원추형 연결부 + 플랫폼 스위칭 골수준 임플란트, 치조정하 식립, 10년 추적): 1 mm IID를 10년 정량 추적한 최초 임상 보고.
🟡 조건부 반박overviews
이갈이·저작근 과활성 축 — 교합·TMD·보철/임플란트 과부하의 공통 상류 인자 종합
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis positioning bruxism as a shared upstream driver across three downstream pathways: excess masticatory-muscle force, when PDL/peri-implant shock absorption is insufficient, discharges into TMJ (pain/derangement; pooled TMD prevalence ~31%, Valesan 2021 SR+MA), tooth-restoration (wear, cracked tooth, prosthesis fracture), or implant hardware (late failure — PDL absent, Song 2021).
이갈이를 공통 상류 인자로 묶은 종합: 과도한 저작근 힘이 치주인대(PDL)·임플란트 주위 완충을 초과하면 가장 약한 구조로 방전된다 — 턱관절장애(TMD, 유병률 ~31%; Valesan 2021 SR+MA)·치아-보철(마모·균열·파절)·임플란트 하드웨어 (late failure; PDL 부재, Song 2021).
VS
Implant complications in bruxism patients
Song J-Y · 2021 narrative-review
JKAOMS Editor's Opinion (2-page narrative commentary, Jeju National University) reviewing 9 cited works on bruxism and implant complications; not a SR/MA.
JKAOMS Editor's Opinion (2 pages, 제주대학교) — 이갈이와 임플란트 합병증에 관한 9편 인용 서술적 논평; SR/MA 아님.

Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 5 papers on peri-implantitis risk *assessment and prediction* (as opposed to management), spanning two umbrella reviews of risk factors (Giok 2024, Tarce 2025 = PiRA Part 1), a retrospective predictive-model build (Quirynen 2025 = PiRA Part 2), an e-cigarette umbrella review (Fathi 2024), and a mucositis-adjunct umbrella review (Chuachamsai 2022).

Peri-implantitis Risk Assessment (PiRA) Part 1: Umbrella Review of a Multifactorial Disease with Many Risk Factors
Mihai Tarce, Marc Quirynen · 2025 sr+ma
Umbrella review of 49 systematic reviews (30 patient-related [15 with meta-analysis], 19 treatment-related [9 with meta-analysis]), screened from 4,724 records down to 103 SR candidates, identifying preoperative peri-implantitis risk factors as the evidence base for a clinical risk-assessment tool (PiRA).
우산리뷰(Umbrella Review) — 체계적 문헌고찰(Systematic Review, SR) 49편(환자 관련 30편[메타분석 15편], 치료 관련 19편[메타분석 9편])을 4,724편 중 103편 후보에서 선별, 임상 위험평가 도구(PiRA) 개발을 위한 술전 peri-implantitis 위험인자를 식별.

Overview: Osteotomy Drilling Heat — Modifiable Determinants Ranked, and the Osseointegration Consequence
synthesis
Synthesis of 28 papers on implant osteotomy drilling heat, reorganized from "list of factors" into an evidence-weighted ranking of *what to actually control*: the 47°C/1-min necrosis threshold (Timon 2019 cross-specialty; ~50°C orthopedic), a multifactorial framing (Chauhan 2018 SR 34 studies; Jung 2021 internal-vs-external taxonomy), and the biological endpoint (Heuzeroth 2021 in vivo minipig, n=36; Kosior 2025 histologic bone-bed scoring).
임플란트 골절제 드릴링 발열 28편을 "요인 나열"이 아니라 **무엇을 실제로 통제할지의 근거가중 순위**로 재구성: 47°C/1분 괴사 역치(Timon 2019 교차검증; 정형외과 ~50°C), 다인자 프레이밍(Chauhan 2018 SR 34편; Jung 2021 내부·외부 인자 분류), 생물학적 endpoint(Heuzeroth 2021 in vivo 미니피그 n=36; Kosior 2025 조직학적 골상 점수).
VS

Sihana Rugova, Marcus Abboud · 2024 in-vitro
In vitro infrared thermography study (Bioengineering 2024; custom drill press, 5 drill bits, artificial bone, no irrigation) testing the assumption that sequential drilling protects against thermal damage to bone.
인비트로 적외선 열화상(Infrared Thermography) 연구(Bioengineering 2024; 맞춤 드릴 프레스, 5개 드릴, 합성골, **irrigation 없음**) — sequential drilling이 골 열손상을 방지한다는 임상 가정 검증.

Synthesis · 2026 synthesis

Implant Stability Quotient (ISQ / RFA) — Measurement·Threshold·Loading Decision Ladder
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Decision-ladder synthesis of ~40 ISQ/RFA papers across 3 axes: (1) measurement device — Osstell (ISQ 1–100) recommended over Periotest for interpretability, SmartPeg torque ≥10 Ncm required for accuracy; Anycheck (DCA) is a valid operator-independent alternative; (2) loading threshold — ISQ ≥70 at placement OR ≥65 after 4–6 weeks is the early/immediate-loading cutoff, with immediate loading additionally requiring IT ≥35 Ncm (Andersson 2019 n=745; Wittneben 2023 SR); Type IV bone normally runs ISQ 58–65 — do not auto-delay.
ISQ/RFA 40편 의사결정 ladder 3축: (1) 측정 도구 — Osstell(ISQ 1–100, 직관적) 1차 권장, SmartPeg 토크 ≥10 Ncm 표준화 필수, Anycheck(DCA)는 측정자 독립적 대안; (2) 임계값 — 식립 시 ISQ ≥70 또는 4–6주 후 ≥65가 조기/즉시 부하 기준, 즉시 부하는 추가로 IT ≥35 Ncm 필요(Andersson 2019 n=745; Wittneben 2023 SR); Type IV 골은 ISQ 58–65가 정상분포 — 자동 지연 결정 금지.

Maxillary Molar Immediate Implant — Palatal Root Socket Anchorage (Decision Synthesis)
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Cross-paper synthesis on using the palatal root socket as primary anchorage for maxillary molar immediate implant placement (IIP) when the inter-radicular septum is inadequate (IRS fits a ≥5 mm implant in only 61.7% of first molars and 34% of second molars on CBCT), covering anatomy, biomechanical rationale, stability behavior, sinus constraint, soft-tissue healing, and All-on-X cantilever-avoidance application.

synthesis
Synthesis of 8 papers (1 SR+MA, 3 SRs, 2 retrospective, 2 RCTs): zirconia implants achieve high medium-to-long-term survival (Mohseni 2024 SR+MA, 25 studies / 4,017 implants: 10-yr CSR 95.1%; MBL ~0.005 mm/month), with high patient-reported satisfaction in aesthetics, comfort, and chewing (Arefnia 2025 SR, 12 controlled studies), on par with titanium.

TMD Pain — Etiologic Associations (Sleep · Tooth Loss · Extraction) & Treatment Modalities (LLLT · TENS · Prolotherapy · Joint Replacement)
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Evidence hub over 8 papers organizing TMD along two axes — etiologic associations and treatment modalities: the **sleep–TMD association is best-supported**, corroborated from prevalence SR (Albadi: ~90% poor sleep in TMD vs ~15% non-TMD) to Mendelian-randomization causal evidence (Jiang: long sleep OR 6.77, 95% CI 1.73–26.55, p=.006, specific to *chronic* TMD pain, with short-sleep/insomnia signals dissolving after BMI/diabetes adjustment); tooth loss drives chewing-discomfort *severity* while TMD drives the *stress/insomnia* burden (Jeon, n=392); and the extraction–TMD link is weakest and direction-conflicted (Aggarwal SR+MA pooled RR 0.49 favoring extraction, but driven by therapeutic removal of interfering teeth, with observational cohorts showing extraction increasing risk; GRADE low-to-moderate).
TMD 통증을 병인연관(수면·치아상실·발치)과 치료modality(LLLT·TENS·증식치료·인공관절)로 종합한 8편 허브: 수면–TMD 연관이 가장 확고(Albadi poor sleep ~90% vs ~15%; Jiang MR 긴 수면 OR 6.77, 만성 통증 특이적), 치아상실은 저작곤란 중증도를·TMD는 스트레스/불면 부담을 좌우(Jeon), 발치–TMD는 가장 약하고 방향충돌(Aggarwal pooled RR 0.49지만 치료적 발치 효과가 견인, 관찰코호트는 위험↑, GRADE low-moderate).

Systemic & Host Risk Factors → Dental Implant Survival — Cross-Cutting Risk-Stratification Synthesis
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Cross-cutting risk-stratification synthesis of 8 papers (6 umbrella reviews + 1 prospective cohort + 1 ROBIS methods appraisal) on which systemic/host factors actually lower implant survival: **smoking is the firmest risk factor** (15/17 SRs significant; meta-analytic RR/OR ≈ 1.9–2.9, dose-response threshold ≥10 cig/day; Banerjee 2024), and **head-and-neck radiotherapy is next** (success 86.2% irradiated vs 95.2% non-irradiated; Zarzar 2023) — both are elevate-and-consent factors, not contraindications.
전신질환·숙주인자가 임플란트 생존을 실제 낮추는지 종합한 8편(umbrella 6 + 전향 코호트 1 + 방법론 1): **흡연이 가장 확고한 위험인자**(17개 SR 중 15개 유의, 메타 RR/OR ≈ 1.9–2.9, ≥10개비/일 용량반응; Banerjee 2024), **두경부 방사선치료가 다음**(성공 86.2% vs 95.2%; Zarzar 2023) — 둘 다 금기가 아닌 사전동의·프로토콜 조정 대상.

미성숙 영구치 REP 지지체·차단재 선택 — PRP/PRF vs 혈병, WMTA vs 바이오세라믹 변색 위험

Two papers (Alqedairi 2026 narrative review; Li 2026 SR+MA, 15 studies, 4 RCTs, PROSPERO CRD420261337704) add material-selection refinements to the established REP framework: PRP/PRF scaffolds outperform blood clot for dentinal wall thickening while periapical healing equivalence is maintained, and White MTA achieves near-perfect radiographic success (pooled 0.99) but carries a 58.33% tooth discolouration rate versus 7.69% for alternative bioceramics (P=.01).

Overview: 비우식성 치경부 병소(NCCL) — 병인·진단·관찰 vs 수복 의사결정
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 36 papers on noncarious cervical lesions (NCCL): etiology is multifactorial (stress + friction + biocorrosion), and the abfraction-as-sole-cause hypothesis remains clinically unproven — three SRs conflict, and the first long-term cohort (Giller 2024, SHIP 16 years) shows occlusal wear co-occurs with NCCLs cross-sectionally (OR 1.74) but does not significantly predict NCCL progression longitudinally (OR 1.14, 95% CI 0.99–1.30); modifiable dentin-hypersensitivity correlates include post-meal brushing, whitening toothpaste and anxiety, with soft brushes and oral-health knowledge protective (Zimmer 2025).
비우식성 치경부 병소(Noncarious Cervical Lesion, NCCL) 36편 종합 — 병인은 다인성이며 abfraction 단독원인설은 미입증: SR 3편이 충돌하고, 최초 16년 코호트(Giller 2024)는 교합 마모(Occlusal Wear, OW)–NCCL이 횡단면으로는 연관(OR 1.74)되나 종단으로는 진행을 예측하지 못함(OR 1.14, 비유의)을 보였다; 상아질 과민증(Dentin Hypersensitivity, DH)의 교정 가능한 연관인자는 식후 즉시 칫솔질·미백치약·불안, 보호인자는 부드러운 칫솔·구강보건 지식(Zimmer 2025).

Randomized Clinical Trial of Four Adhesion Strategies in Non-Carious Cervical Lesions: Five-Year Follow-Up
Omoto ÉM, Pavani CC, de Andrade Carvalho · 2025 rct
5-year follow-up of a split-mouth RCT restoring 200 non-carious cervical lesions (NCCLs) with Scotchbond Universal without (SBU) or with selective enamel etching (E-SBU), or Vitremer RMGIC without (RMGIC) or with EDTA pretreatment (E-RMGIC); 119 restorations re-evaluated.
비우식성 치경부 병소(NCCL) 200개 split-mouth RCT 5년 추적: SBU 단독·E-SBU(selective enamel etching)·RMGIC(Vitremer)·E-RMGIC(EDTA 전처리) 4군, 119개 재평가.
🟡 조건부 반박overviews
Overview: 비우식성 치경부 병소(NCCL) — 병인·진단·관찰 vs 수복 의사결정
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 36 papers on noncarious cervical lesions (NCCL): etiology is multifactorial (stress + friction + biocorrosion), and the abfraction-as-sole-cause hypothesis remains clinically unproven — three SRs conflict, and the first long-term cohort (Giller 2024, SHIP 16 years) shows occlusal wear co-occurs with NCCLs cross-sectionally (OR 1.74) but does not significantly predict NCCL progression longitudinally (OR 1.14, 95% CI 0.99–1.30); modifiable dentin-hypersensitivity correlates include post-meal brushing, whitening toothpaste and anxiety, with soft brushes and oral-health knowledge protective (Zimmer 2025).
비우식성 치경부 병소(Noncarious Cervical Lesion, NCCL) 36편 종합 — 병인은 다인성이며 abfraction 단독원인설은 미입증: SR 3편이 충돌하고, 최초 16년 코호트(Giller 2024)는 교합 마모(Occlusal Wear, OW)–NCCL이 횡단면으로는 연관(OR 1.74)되나 종단으로는 진행을 예측하지 못함(OR 1.14, 비유의)을 보였다; 상아질 과민증(Dentin Hypersensitivity, DH)의 교정 가능한 연관인자는 식후 즉시 칫솔질·미백치약·불안, 보호인자는 부드러운 칫솔·구강보건 지식(Zimmer 2025).

Longevity of a single-dose, dual-cure universal adhesive: A 7.5-year double-blind split-mouth two-center randomized trial

Double-blind split-mouth multicenter RCT (n=50, 200 NCCLs, 4 strategies: SEE/SET/ERDry/ERWet) evaluating Futurabond U universal adhesive over 7.5 years — the longest follow-up to date for a universal adhesive in NCCLs, with 135 restorations analyzed at final recall.
이중맹검 분할구강 다기관 무작위대조시험(50명, 비우식성 치경부 병소(NCCL) 200개, 4술식: 자가산부식(SEE)·선택적 법랑질 산부식+자가산부식(SET)·산부식-세척 건조 상아질(ERDry)·산부식-세척 습윤 상아질(ERWet)) — 범용 접착제(Futurabond U)의 7.5년 추적 관찰, NCCL 대상 범용 접착제 장기 임상 연구 중 최장 추적.
🟡 조건부 반박overviews
Implant Macrogeometry (Length · Diameter · Insertion Torque) → Primary Stability / ISQ — Determinant Synthesis
Synthesis (Damian Lee) · 2026 synthesis
Determinant synthesis of 8 papers (4 clinical/RFA + 4 in-vitro/FEA) on whether implant diameter or length governs primary stability/ISQ: across every clinical study that tested it, **diameter is the significant driver (narrower = worse) while length is repeatedly non-significant** or significant only in soft bone — Gómez-Polo 2016 (n=88 implants) IT 26.5→33.8 N/cm for 3.75→4.25 mm (p=.002); Huang 2016 (n=329) diameter the strongest secondary-ISQ predictor (β=0.414); Quesada-García 2012 (n=235) narrow diameter → lower 12-week ISQ (P<.001); Barikani 2013 length effect present only in D3 bone.
임플란트 직경 vs 길이가 1차 안정성/ISQ를 좌우하는지 종합한 8편(임상 RFA 4 + 체외/FEA 4): 이를 검증한 모든 임상연구에서 **직경이 유의한 결정인자(좁을수록 나쁨), 길이는 반복적으로 무의**이거나 연질골에서만 유의 — Gómez-Polo 2016(n=88) IT 26.5→33.8 N/cm(3.75→4.25mm, p=.002); Huang 2016(n=329) 직경이 2차 ISQ 최강 예측인자(β=0.414); Quesada-García 2012(n=235) 좁은 직경→12주 ISQ 저하(P<.001); Barikani 2013 길이 효과는 D3 연질골 한정.

Mathematical evaluation of the influence of multiple factors on implant stability quotient values in clinical practice: a retrospective study
Hairong Huang, Daniel Wismeijer, Xianhon · 2016 retrospective
Retrospective single-surgeon, single-implant-system study of 329 SICace implants in 177 patients used multivariate linear regression to identify which of 11 candidate factors significantly influence ISQ at T1 (immediately post-placement) and T2 (pre-restoration).
177명 환자, SICace 임플란트 329개 대상 단일술자 후향적 연구에서 다변량 선형회귀로 T1(식립직후) ISQ 유의 요인 7개, T2(보철직전) ISQ 유의 요인 3개를 규명.

Does Length, Diameter, or Bone Quality Affect Primary and Secondary Stability in Self-Tapping Dental Implants?
Miguel Gómez-Polo, Rocío Ortega, Cristin · 2016 prospective
Prospective longitudinal clinical study of 88 self-tapping InHex implants in 63 partially edentulous patients, testing the effect of implant diameter (3.75 vs 4.25 mm), length (10 vs 11.5 mm), and Lekholm-Zarb bone quality on insertion torque (IT) and primary/secondary implant stability quotient (ISQ).
전향적 종적 임상연구(부분무치악 환자 63명, InHex self-tapping 임플란트 88본)로 임플란트 직경(3.75/4.25mm)·길이(10/11.5mm)·Lekholm-Zarb 골질이 삽입토크 (Insertion Torque, IT) 및 1차·2차 임플란트 안정성 지수 (Implant Stability Quotient, ISQ)에 미치는 영향을 분석.

Overview: Late/Established Implant Failure & Marginal Bone Loss — Risk Factor Synthesis
synthesis
Synthesis of 28 papers on late/established implant failure and marginal bone loss (MBL) — i.e., after successful osseointegration, distinct from early (pre-loading) failure covered in [[overviews/early-implant-failure-risk-prevention-overview]] — built on ten umbrella/synthesis anchors, the primary SR+MA and cohort layer beneath them (since umbrella reviews grade evidence without reporting effect sizes), and, since 2026-08-06, a pooled **reference baseline** (kumar-2021: 0.56 mm 1-year MBL) that gives the risk-factor deltas below a denominator to be read against.
후기(정착 후) 임플란트 실패·변연골소실(MBL) 관련 논문 **24편** 종합 — 로딩 전 조기실패는 [[overviews/early-implant-failure-risk-prevention-overview]]와 상호보완. 우산리뷰 10편을 축으로 삼되, **우산리뷰는 등급만 매기고 효과크기를 안 주므로** 그 아래 1차 SR+MA·코호트 층을 함께 싣고, 여기에 위험인자 차이값을 읽을 **기준선**(kumar-2021, 1년 pooled MBL 0.56 mm)을 더한다.

Overview: Topical Anesthetics for Injection and Needle-Stick Pain
synthesis · 2026 synthesis
Synthesis of 6 papers: topical anesthetics reduce needle/injection pain versus placebo (concentration-dependent from 5% to 20%; Khongkhunthian 2018) — though the placebo-controlled certainty is GRADE-low and raising concentration above the standard adds nothing (20% vs 10% benzocaine trivial, RR 0.93, moderate certainty; Miroshnychenko 2023 SR+MA) — while head-to-head agent comparisons (benzocaine, lidocaine, EMLA) are inconsistent: a small low-power RCT (Subramanian 2023) favored benzocaine, a triple-blind RCT (Karkoutly 2024) showed no agent difference.
6편 종합: 표면마취제는 위약 대비 needle·주사 통증을 줄이나(농도 의존, 5%→20%; Khongkhunthian 2018) 그 위약 대비 우위의 확실성은 GRADE low이고 표준 농도 위로의 증량은 trivial(20% vs 10% benzocaine RR 0.93, moderate; Miroshnychenko 2023 SR+MA), 제제 간 비교는 비일관적 — 소규모 RCT(Subramanian 2023)는 benzocaine 우위, 더 엄격한 triple-blind RCT(Karkoutly 2024)는 차이 없음.
